Rad9 は DSB の末端での Sgs1 の結合を妨げて Sgs1/Dna2: Rad9 blocks Sgs1 binding at DSB ends and restrains Sgs1/Dna2 resection (25637499). Reduced Rad9 binding to DNA ends relieves the inhibition of Sgs1-Dna2 activity (26584331)
Rad9 はクロマチン上で NuA4 のアセチル化活性を試験管内で抑える。G1: Rad9 inhibits NuA4 acetyltransferase activity on chromatin in vitro. In G1, Rad9 and NHEJ factors prevent NuA4 recruitment to DSBs (34543274)

Mec1 promotes Rad9 binding to damage sites, leading to full phosphorylation and binding to Rad53 (15060150)
Ram1-Ram2 はファルネシル転移酵素で Ras の膜局在に要る（17630: Ram1-Ram2 is a farnesyltransferase required for Ras membrane localization (1763050). ram2 mutants also lack Ras2 farnesylation activity (2124698)
Rap1 は ATF1 の活性化に必須な 18 bp の配列に結合し、ATF1: Rap1 binds an 18 bp sequence essential for ATF1 activation, and activation of ATF1 transcription depends on Rap1 (10487921)
Rap1 は Tel1 と Mec1 によって S731 がリン酸化され、DNA: Rap1 S731 is phosphorylated by Tel1 and Mec1, increasing with DNA damage and telomere shortening. Impaired phosphorylation weakens Rap1-Rif1 binding and disrupts end protection. S731D strengthens binding to Rif1 (28575419)

Rav1・Rav2 を FLAG で精製した RAVE 複合体に V1 サブユニ: The RAVE complex purified via FLAG-tagged Rav1 and Rav2 contains the V1 subunits Vma1p and Vma2p (28643238)
Rav2 は Rav1 の N 末端ドメインに結合する（共免疫沈降・ツーハイブリ: Rav2 binds the N-terminal domain of Rav1 (co-immunoprecipitation, two-hybrid, pull-down) (26405040)
Rax1 は二極出芽の遠位の目印 Bud8 の局在に必要（14980713）: Rax1 is required for localization of Bud8, the distal landmark for bipolar budding (14980713)
Rax1p と Rax2p の局在は相互依存で、酵母から共精製される。Bud8p: Localization of Rax1p and Rax2p is interdependent, and they copurify from yeast. Bud8p and Bud9p also copurify with Rax1p (15356260)
Rba50 は Rpb3 と、Gpn2 は Rpb12 と結合し、Rpb3 サブ: Rba50 binds Rpb3 and Gpn2 binds Rpb12, acting in assembly of the Rpb3 subcomplex (29661922)
Rbg1 と Tma46 の C 末端領域の複合体の結晶構造を決め、Tma46: The crystal structure of the complex of Rbg1 and the C-terminal region of Tma46 was determined; Tma46 contributes to Rbg1 GTPase activity and function (23002146)
Rbg2・Gir2 は単独では不安定だが、複合体を作って互いを安定化し、アミノ酸: Rbg2 and Gir2 are unstable alone but form a complex that stabilizes each other, which is strongly enhanced under amino acid starvation (23899355)
Rbl2 は生体内で β チューブリンに結合し、過剰な β チューブリンによる致: Rbl2 binds β-tubulin in vivo and suppresses lethality caused by excess β-tubulin (7634332)
Rbp1 はミトコンドリアのポリン（POR1）mRNA の分解を速めてその量を下: Rbp1 accelerates decay of mitochondrial porin (POR1) mRNA, lowering its level. Decay is mediated by Xrn1. Rbp1 binds Dhh1 directly (16885161)
Rbp29（Sgn1）は Pab1 と RNA 依存に共免疫沈降し、poly(A: Rbp29 (Sgn1) co-immunoprecipitates with Pab1 in an RNA-dependent manner and binds poly(A) (10764794)
Rbp95 は Npa1 複合体の多くの構成要素とリボソームタンパク質 Rpl3: Rbp95 is genetically and physically linked to many components of the Npa1 complex and to the ribosomal protein Rpl3 (36018804)
Rbs1 の過剰発現で RPB10 mRNA と Rpb10 タンパク質が増える: Rbs1 overexpression increases RPB10 mRNA and Rpb10 protein. Rbs1 binds directly to the 3'UTR of RPB10 mRNA (33231687)
Rce1 の阻害剤で GFP-Ras の細胞膜の局在が崩れ、RCE1 の増量で抑: An Rce1 inhibitor disrupts plasma membrane localization of GFP-Ras, which is suppressed by increased RCE1. Genetic loss of CaaX cleavage mislocalizes GFP-Ras2 to ER-positive puncta (20162532)
Rcf1 は Cox13 と Rcf2 の複合体への組み込みと、一部の複合体 I: Rcf1 is required for incorporation of Cox13 and Rcf2 into the complex and for formation of respiratory supercomplexes by part of complex IV (22342701)
Rcf2 と Rcf3 は新しく合成されたミトコンドリアのコードするタンパク質（: Rcf2 and Rcf3 bind newly synthesized mitochondrially encoded proteins (such as Cox3) and contribute to complex IV assembly (34450214)
Rcf2 と Rcf3 は新生の Cox3 などのミトコンドリアでコードされるタ: Rcf2 and Rcf3 bind nascent mitochondrially encoded proteins such as Cox3 and contribute to complex IV assembly (34450214)
Rck1 は Ubp3 と直接結合して Ubp3 のリン酸化を活性化する。UBP: Rck1 binds Ubp3 directly and activates Ubp3 phosphorylation. Without UBP3, the increase in Ras2 caused by RCK1 overexpression does not occur (26657849)
Rcl1 の核内輸送は Bms1 に依存し、両者は同じ段階でプレリボソームに載る: Nuclear import of Rcl1 depends on Bms1, and both load onto pre-ribosomes at the same stage (25064857)
Rcl1・U3 snoRNA・GTP の Bms1 への結合は強く共役し、Rcl: Binding of Rcl1, U3 snoRNA and GTP to Bms1 is tightly coupled, suggesting that Rcl1 activates Bms1 by promoting GDP/GTP exchange (16376378)
Rcn1 は Mck1 にリン酸化されると SCF-Cdc4 で分解され、これが: When phosphorylated by Mck1, Rcn1 is degraded by SCF-Cdc4, relieving inhibition of calcineurin. Degradation is promoted by Ca2+ (17954914)
Rcn2 はカルシニューリンの触媒サブユニットのうち Cmp2 に優先して結合し: Among the calcineurin catalytic subunits, Rcn2 binds preferentially to Cmp2 and partially inhibits calcineurin. This binding and the reduced activity are important for suppression of vps13Δ (33530471)
Rco1 の SID は Eaf3 の H3K36 メチル化ペプチドへの選択的な: The Rco1 SID allosterically promotes selective binding of Eaf3 to H3K36-methylated peptides (25578729)
Rcp10p（Ysf3）は SF3b の p10 で、Cus1p の量を保つのと: Rcp10p (Ysf3) is p10 of SF3b and is required to maintain Cus1p levels and for U2 snRNP incorporation (16314500)
Rcr1 はエクソマーで細胞膜に運ばれる Rsp5 のアダプターで、カルシニュー: Rcr1 is an Rsp5 adaptor transported to the plasma membrane by exomer and is induced by the calcineurin/Crz1 pathway. With external calcium, Rcr1 ubiquitinates Chs3 and reduces it (32421152)
Rcr2 はユビキチンを選別の信号として液胞へ運ばれる。本文: rsp5-1 の: Rcr2 is transported to the vacuole using ubiquitin as a sorting signal. Full text: at the semi-permissive temperature of rsp5-1, Rcr2 is rerouted to the plasma membrane, and without the PY motif (Rsp5 binding) it does not reach the vacuole (32421152)
Rdi1 は Cdc42・Rho1・Rho4 とだけ結合し、それぞれ別の仕組みで: Rdi1 binds only Cdc42, Rho1 and Rho4, regulating each by a distinct mechanism. After extraction from membranes by Rdi1, Rho4 is degraded by a novel mechanism involving Ygk3, vacuolar proteases and the proteasome
Rdi1 を過剰発現すると細胞の形の異常、ALP の選別の遅れ、液胞の断片化が起: Rdi1 overexpression causes abnormal cell morphology, delayed ALP sorting and vacuole fragmentation, linked to reduced membrane localization and activation of Cdc42 and Rho1. Rdi1 binds Rho GTPases and inhibits vacuole membrane fusion (21171963). Consistent with the UniProt direction (inhibition)
Rdr1 は PDR5 を含む 5 つの遺伝子の転写を抑える。Δrdr1 で P: Rdr1 represses transcription of five genes including PDR5. PDR5-lacZ activity rises in Δrdr1 (11882665)
Rds3 の最初の亜鉛フィンガーの上流の変異で Ist3 が条件的に外れ、Rse: Mutations upstream of the first zinc finger of Rds3 conditionally release Ist3 and also weaken binding to Rse1 (14517302)
Rea1 と Rix1 複合体（Rix1-Ipi1-Ipi3）は核質の 60S: Rea1 and the Rix1 complex (Rix1-Ipi1-Ipi3) are components of nucleoplasmic 60S precursor particles (15260980)
Rea1 の MIDAS が Rsa4 に結合し、その結合が pre-60S か: The Rea1 MIDAS binds Rsa4, and this binding is essential for ATP-dependent release of factors from pre-60S (19737519)
Rec102・Rec104・Spo11 は減数分裂で互いに相互作用し、三量体を作: Rec102, Rec104 and Spo11 interact with each other in meiosis and are thought to form a trimer (12897161)
Rec102・Rec104・Spo11 は減数分裂で互いに相互作用する。Rec1: Rec102, Rec104 and Spo11 interact with each other in meiosis. Rec104-Rec102 binding occurs even without Spo11 (12897161)
Rec114 の局在はほかの DSB 因子に依存しないが、Mei4 の局在は R: Rec114 localization does not depend on other DSB factors, but Mei4 localization strongly depends on Rec114 and Mer2 (17558514)
Rec8 の複数のリン酸化部位と CK1δ/ε・DDK の 2 つのキナーゼが: Multiple Rec8 phosphorylation sites and two kinases, CK1δ/ε and DDK, are required for Rec8 cleavage and nuclear division in meiosis I. Full text: DDK and Hrr25 bind and phosphorylate Rec8 from S phase/prophase, and chromosomal Rec8 with both inhibited is a poor separase substrate in vitro (20230747)
Rec8 の複数のリン酸化部位と CK1δ/ε（Hrr25）・DDK の 2 つ: Multiple Rec8 phosphorylation sites and two kinases, CK1δ/ε (Hrr25) and DDK, are required for Rec8 cleavage and nuclear division in meiosis I. Phosphomimetic Rec8 is cleaved even when the kinases are inhibited (20230747). In meiosis II, Hrr25 phosphorylates Rec8 while removing shugoshin-PP2A from kinetochores, preparing for cleavage (28017619)
Red1 のリン酸化は CDC28 に依存する部分と依存しない部分があり、リン酸: Red1 phosphorylation is partly CDC28-dependent and partly independent, and loss of phosphorylation does not impair meiotic function (21173162)
Red1 は Mek1 の基質ではなく、野生型レベルの Mek1 のキナーゼ活性: Red1 is not a Mek1 substrate, but RED1 is required for wild-type levels of Mek1 kinase activity. Mek1 activation requires HOP1, the Red1/Hop1 complex and the Mek1 FHA domain, and a constitutively active mek1 mutant bypasses the RED1 requirement (14595109)
Reg1 は Glc7 を Snf1 複合体に連れてきて、活性化した Snf1: Reg1 brings Glc7 to the Snf1 complex and returns activated Snf1 to an autoinhibited state (10648618). In high glucose, Reg1-Glc7 and Sit4 dephosphorylate Snf1 T210 (24019512)
Reg2 は Snf1 T210 の脱リン酸化に関わり、リン酸化された Snf1: Reg2 is involved in dephosphorylation of Snf1 T210 and binds phosphorylated Snf1. reg2-deficient cells starved of glucose for a long time show delayed T210 dephosphorylation and growth recovery when glucose is restored (27107116)
Rei1 と Jjj1 は直接結合する。Jjj1 の C 末端の電荷に富む領域が: Rei1 and Jjj1 bind directly. The charged C-terminal region of Jjj1 mediates binding and is required for 60S formation in vivo (19901025)
Rfa2 と Dun1 は生体内で DNA 損傷でリン酸化され、試験管内で Te: Rfa2 and Dun1 are phosphorylated in vivo upon DNA damage and are substrates of Tel1 and Mec1 in vitro (12967660)
Rfa2 は試験管内で Tel1 と Mec1 の基質になる（12967660）: Rfa2 is a substrate of Tel1 and Mec1 in vitro (12967660)
Rfu1 は単量体のユビキチンと遊離のユビキチン鎖の量を調節し、脱ユビキチン化酵: Rfu1 regulates the levels of monomeric ubiquitin and free ubiquitin chains and acts as an inhibitor of the deubiquitinase Doa4. Doa4 and Rfu1 are partly involved in the rapid decrease of free ubiquitin chains upon heat shock (19410548). Consistent with the GO direction (inhibition)
Rga1 は HOG 経路の中の Cdc42 を下げるが、接合経路の Cdc42: Rga1 lowers Cdc42 within the HOG pathway but not Cdc42 of the mating pathway. With RGA1 lacking the C-terminal GAP domain, the mating MAPK is activated under hyperosmotic stress (34680163)
Rga1 は Nba1・Nis1 と相互作用して直前と古い分裂部位に一時的に局在: Rga1 interacts with Nba1 and Nis1 and transiently localizes to the immediately previous and older division sites. The Rga1 LIM domain is required for binding Nba1; losing this binding makes Rga1 leave the previous division site early and disrupts bud-site selection in daughter cells
Rga1 は Rga2 と同じく Cdc28 による抑制のリン酸化を受け、高浸透: Like Rga2, Rga1 undergoes inhibitory phosphorylation by Cdc28 and is dephosphorylated and activated under hyperosmotic stress (34680163)
Rga1 は試験管内で Hog1 にリン酸化されるが、その直接のリン酸化は体内の: Rga1 is phosphorylated by Hog1 in vitro, but this direct phosphorylation is not required for its function in vivo. Rga1 undergoes inhibitory phosphorylation by Cdc28 and is dephosphorylated and activated under hyperosmotic stress. Hog1 blocks Cdc28 phosphorylation and permits dephosphorylation by PP2A, activating Rga1 (34680163)
Rga2 の CDK 部位は Pho85 と Cdc28 に体内・試験管内でリン: The CDK sites of Rga2 are phosphorylated by Pho85 and Cdc28 in vivo and in vitro, and mutating them abolishes G1-specific phosphorylation. Phosphorylation inhibits Rga2 activity, allowing proper activation of Cdc42 (17853895)
The CDK sites of Rga2 are phosphorylated by Pho85 and Cdc28 in vivo and in vitro, and mutation abolishes G1-specific phosphorylation. CDK phosphorylation inhibits Rga2 activity (17853895)
Rgc1（Ypr115w）と Rgc2（Ask10）は Fps1 グリセロールチ: Rgc1 (Ypr115w) and Rgc2 (Ask10) are positive regulators of the Fps1 glycerol channel. In rgc1/2Δ, Fps1 function is lost and glycerol accumulates, which is restored by Fps1 overexpression. Regulation by Rgc1/2 appears indirect, but it controls channel activity rather than Fps1 expression, folding or localization (19956799)
Rgc2 は浸透圧ストレスのないとき Fps1 の C 末端に PH ドメインで: In the absence of osmotic stress, Rgc2 binds the Fps1 C-terminus via its PH domain and keeps the channel open. When Hog1 is activated by hyperosmotic stress, Rgc2 is rapidly removed from Fps1 and the channel closes. Hog1 is recruited to the Fps1 N-terminus and from there phosphorylates Rgc2 at multiple sites (24298058). Hog1 phosphorylation of Rgc1 and Rgc2 causes their release from Fps1 and channel closure (26024902)
Rgc2 は浸透圧ストレスのないとき Fps1 の C 末端の細胞質ドメインに結: In the absence of osmotic stress, Rgc2 binds the C-terminal cytoplasmic domain of Fps1 and keeps it open (24298058). Rgc1 and Rgc2 (Ask10) are positive regulators of Fps1; rgc1/2Δ accumulates glycerol, restored by Fps1 overexpression. Rgc1/2 regulate channel activity rather than Fps1 expression, folding or localization (19956799)
Rgd1 は Rho2・Rho3・Rho4 の活性型と two-hybrid で: Rgd1 binds the active forms of Rho2, Rho3 and Rho4 by two-hybrid and stimulates the GTPase activity of Rho3 and Rho4 in vitro (not Rho2). rho3Δ rgd1Δ grows much worse than the single mutants, suggesting it acts as a GAP in vivo as well (10526184). As a GAP, it inhibits. Consistent with the current direction (inhibition)
Rgm1 を含む 26 の転写因子が CMK2 の転写を正に制御する（40816: 26 transcription factors including Rgm1 positively regulate CMK2 transcription (40816512)
Rgs2 を欠くとグルコースによる cAMP の増加が強まり、過剰発現で弱まる。: Loss of Rgs2 enhances the glucose-induced cAMP increase, and overexpression weakens it. Rgs2 directly activates the GTPase of Gpa2, negatively regulating glucose cAMP signaling (10523302)
Rgt1 は HXT3 プロモーターの複数の部位に体内で結合して転写を相乗的に抑: Rgt1 binds multiple sites in the HXT3 promoter in vivo and synergistically represses transcription. Hyperphosphorylated Rgt1 in high glucose does not bind DNA (12861007)
Rgt1 はグルコースがないときだけ Std1・Mth1 と two-hybri: Rgt1 binds Std1 and Mth1 by two-hybrid and co-precipitates with them in vivo only in the absence of glucose. In the std1 mth1 double mutant, Rgt1-mediated HXT repression is lost and Rgt1 is constitutively phosphorylated (14508605)
Rgt1 はグルコースがないときは HXT 遺伝子のリプレッサー。高濃度のグルコ: Rgt1 is a repressor of HXT genes in the absence of glucose. In high glucose it is phosphorylated and converted into an activator, required for maximal HXT1 induction. Because it does not bind the HXT1 promoter in high glucose, the mechanism is thought to be indirect (12527758)
Rgt2 の細胞表面の量は yck1Δ yck2ts で大きく減る（エンドサイト: Cell-surface levels of Rgt2 are greatly reduced in yck1Δ yck2ts (not due to endocytic degradation). Rgt2 is phosphorylated Yck-dependently at Yck sites in its C-terminus, and this glucose-induced modification is essential for its stability and function (35102180). This phosphorylation is required for corepressor (Mth1, Std1) binding and HXT expression (27630263)
Rho ファミリーの GTPase Cdc42 は細胞膜ストレスによる TORC: The Rho-family GTPase Cdc42 contributes to activation of TORC2-Ypk1/2 signaling by plasma membrane stress (35912799)
Rho1 と Pkc1 はセプチンリングを安定させ、その一部は F-BAR タン: Rho1 and Pkc1 stabilize the septin ring, partly through phosphorylation of the F-BAR protein Syp1. When two serines are phosphorylated in a Pkc1-dependent manner, Syp1 leaves the bud neck (26179915)
Rho1 の GAP である SAC7・BEM2 を壊すと Slt2 が常に活性: Disrupting SAC7 and BEM2, the Rho1 GAPs, constitutively activates Slt2. They negatively regulate the cell wall pathway (10625705)
Rho1 は G1/S 移行期に出芽予定部位で Cln2-Cdc28 によって活: Rho1 is activated at the presumptive bud site at the G1/S transition by Cln2-Cdc28, via the Rho1 GEF Tus1 (18256282)
Rho1 は GST-Ste4 と結合し、Gβγ-Rho1 の結合を壊す STE: Rho1 binds GST-Ste4, and STE4 mutations that disrupt Gβγ-Rho1 binding reduce Rho1 localization to the projection tip (12660244)
Rho1 は高い温度でのフォルミンの活性化に必要で、アクチン骨格への主な効果器: Rho1 is required for formin activation at high temperature and acts through Pkc1, its main effector on the actin cytoskeleton. Pkc1 also activates the MAPK pathway, but this pathway does not act in formin activation. Full text: activated Pkc1 lets rho1-2 cells form cable-like filaments from Bni1 overexpression even at 37°C
Rho3 と Rho4 の必須の働きはフォルミン Bni1 と Bnr1 の活性: The essential function of Rho3 and Rho4 is activation of the formins Bni1 and Bnr1; making either formin active renders Rho3 and Rho4 dispensable. The full text states that Rho3 (and then Rho4) releases the binding between the RBD and DAD of Bni1
Rho3 の効果器ドメインの変異解析で、小胞を母細胞から芽へ運ぶ働きは Myo2: Mutational analysis of the Rho3 effector domain indicates that transport of vesicles from mother to bud is mediated by Myo2 (10588647). Rho3 binds Myo2 by two-hybrid and with purified proteins, and effector-domain mutations abolish binding (10207081)
Rho5 は Dck1 と Lmo1 からなる 2 量体の GEF で活性化され: Rho5 is activated by a dimeric GEF composed of Dck1 and Lmo1. Stress-induced translocation of Rho5 to mitochondria depends on both subunits (35887245)
Rib3 の Cys56 が試験管内で Grx2 依存に可逆的に S-グルタチオ: Cys56 of Rib3 is reversibly S-glutathionylated in vitro in a Grx2-dependent manner (21565288)
Ric1 は Rgp1 と固い複合体をつくり、Ric1-Rgp1 は Ypt6: Ric1 forms a tight complex with Rgp1; Ric1-Rgp1 binds Ypt6 in a nucleotide-dependent manner, and the purified complex stimulates guanine nucleotide exchange on Ypt6 in vitro. Loss of RIC1 or RGP1, like ypt6, blocks Snc1 recycling, restored by YPT6 overexpression (10990452). Consistent with the GO direction (activation)
Rie1 の結合相手として RRM タンパク質 Sgn1 を同定。どちらも Im: The RRM protein Sgn1 was identified as a binding partner of Rie1. Both are involved in the timely expression of Ime1 (37638885)
Rif1 と Rif2 は DNA 末端への Tel1 の集まりを抑え、MRX: Rif1 and Rif2 inhibit Tel1 accumulation at DNA ends but not MRX accumulation. Rif2 competes with Tel1 for binding to the Xrs2 C-terminus (19217405). rif2-S6E, which strengthens Rif2-Rad50 binding, suppresses Tel1 binding to DSBs and lowers Tel1 activation (38180815). In a reconstituted system, Rif2 inhibits MRX-dependent Tel1 kinase activity and releases ATP-bound Rad50 (31640985)
Rif1 と Rif2 は別々の仕組みで DNA 末端への Tel1 の集まりを: Rif1 and Rif2 inhibit Tel1 accumulation at DNA ends by distinct mechanisms, without inhibiting MRX accumulation. At short telomeric sequences, Rif1 acts more weakly than Rif2 and partly depends on Rif2 (19217405)
Rif2 の N 末端の BAT モチーフはテロメアの伸長と Tel1 の活性を: The N-terminal BAT motif of Rif2 inhibits telomere elongation and Tel1 activity and also blocks NHEJ and 5′ end resection. It inhibits the DNA end-tethering function of MRX by binding directly to the ATP-bound head of Rad50 (33980827). Rif2 accumulates at DSBs, enhances MRX ATP hydrolysis and weakens the end-tethering function of MRX (26901759)
Rif2 は Mre11 のエンドヌクレアーゼの活性を抑え、sae2Δ で MR: Rif2 inhibits Mre11 endonuclease activity and causes MRX to persist at DSBs in sae2Δ. Rad50 residues required for Rad50-Rif2 binding were identified, and Rif2 is proposed to stabilize a cleavage-incompetent form of Mre11-Rad50, opposite to Sae2 (33789097)
Rim101 の切断による活性化と NRE での抑制には Dfg16・Ygr12: Dfg16, Ygr122w and ESCRT are required for activation of Rim101 by cleavage and for repression at NREs (16024810)
Rim101 は生体内で抑制因子として働き、抑える標的 NRG1・SMP1 のプ: Rim101 acts as a repressor in vivo and binds the promoters of its repressed targets NRG1 and SMP1. Loss of nrg1 and smp1 suppresses rim101Δ defects (12509465)
Rim101 acts as a repressor in vivo and binds the promoters of its repressed targets NRG1 and SMP1 (12509465)
Rim11（GSK3）は Ume6 に結合してリン酸化し、GSK3 部位の置換で: Rim11 (GSK3) binds and phosphorylates Ume6, and substitution of GSK3 sites impairs Ume6-Ime1 binding and meiotic gene expression (9372955). Nitrogen limitation increases Ume6 phosphorylation, which depends on Rim11 and Mck1 and is required for Ume6-Ime1 binding and activation of meiotic genes (10891485)
Rim15 がエンドスルフィン Igo1/2 をリン酸化し、Igo1/2 が P: Rim15 phosphorylates the endosulfines Igo1/2, and Igo1/2 directly inhibit PP2A-Cdc55
Rim15 にリン酸化された Igo1/2 が PP2A-Cdc55 を直接抑え: Igo1/2 phosphorylated by Rim15 directly inhibit PP2A-Cdc55, maintaining the phosphorylated form of Gis1
Rim15 にリン酸化されたエンドスルフィン Igo1/2 が PP2A-Cdc: When the endosulfines Igo1/2 phosphorylated by Rim15 inhibit PP2A-Cdc55, Gis1 is kept phosphorylated, recruited to promoters of nutrient-regulated genes, and activates their transcription (23273919)
Rim15 の核への集積は、Sit4 によらない TOR の下流の枝と Sch9: Nuclear accumulation of Rim15 is inhibited both by a Sit4-independent downstream branch of TOR and by Sch9 (14690612)

SLY41 は PMR1 と負の遺伝的相互作用。Sly41 の過剰発現で細胞質: SLY41 has a negative genetic interaction with PMR1. Sly41 overexpression raises cytosolic Ca and suppresses defects in COPII vesicle tethering (27030673)
SMF3 の鉄による調節はプロモーター（Aft1 の結合部位を含む）を介し、af: Iron regulation of SMF3 is mediated through its promoter (including Aft1-binding sites) and is greatly reduced in the aft1 aft2 double deletion (an Aft-independent pathway also exists) (11829747)
SMP1 の過剰発現は STL1 などの浸透圧応答遺伝子を Hog1 に依存して: SMP1 overexpression induces osmotic-response genes such as STL1 in a Hog1-dependent manner, and their expression is lost in smp1Δ (12482976)
SNF1 三量体コアの構造で Sip2 のグリコーゲン結合ドメインが Snf4: In the structure of the SNF1 trimeric core, the glycogen-binding domain of Sip2 interacts with Snf4 (17851534)
SNF11 は試験管内で SNF2 と結合し、酵母細胞から SNF-SWI 複合: SNF11 binds SNF2 in vitro and copurifies with the SNF-SWI complex from yeast cells (7623818)
SNO-CoA 還元酵素 Adh6 がアセトアセチル CoA チオラーゼを阻害的: The SNO-CoA reductase Adh6 protects acetoacetyl-CoA thiolase from inhibitory S-nitrosylation, affecting sterol synthesis (25512491)
SO2 ストレスで Com2 が活性化遺伝子の発現を制御し、ORT1 は SO2: Under SO2 stress, Com2 controls expression of activated genes, and ORT1 is one of the Com2 targets contributing to SO2 tolerance (31799324)
SO2 ストレスで Com2 の標的のうち SO2 耐性に寄与する 50 遺伝子: Under SO2 stress, the 50 Com2 target genes contributing to SO2 tolerance include LYS21 (31799324)
SOD1 は酸素とグルコースの信号を伝えて呼吸を抑える。その仕組みは Yck1・: SOD1 transmits oxygen and glucose signals to repress respiration. The mechanism is stabilization of Yck1 and Yck2 (CK1γ): SOD1 binds the C-terminal degron of Yck1/Yck2 and stabilizes the kinases through catalysis converting superoxide to hydrogen peroxide (23332757)
SOR2（YIL092W）欠失でアシル鎖が短くなり Acc1 活性が下がると考え: Deletion of SOR2 (YIL092W) shortens acyl chains, and Acc1 activity is thought to decrease. Snf1 activation is unchanged (28076367)
SOR3（YJR039W）の欠失で脂肪酸の鎖長が短くなり、Acc1p が下がって: Deletion of SOR3 (YJR039W) shortens fatty acid chain length, and Acc1p is thought to be reduced (28076367)
SPB の挿入に失敗すると SESA（Smy2・Eap1・Scp160・Asc1: When SPB insertion fails, SESA (Smy2, Eap1, Scp160, Asc1) specifically represses translation initiation of POM34 mRNA, and the decrease in Pom34 restores viability of SPB duplication mutants (19571182)
SPB の部品の変異で Trm1-II-GFP が核膜内膜に均一に分布せず、移行: Mutations in SPB components prevent uniform distribution of Trm1-II-GFP in the inner nuclear membrane; its targeting and retention depend on the SPB. Full text: inactivating Spc110 and others disrupts localization (25482124)
SPB 複製だけに欠陥のある mps1-8 の多コピー抑圧因子として SPC42: SPC42 was obtained as a multicopy suppressor of mps1-8, which is defective only in SPB duplication. Mps1 co-precipitates with Spc42, phosphorylates Spc42 in vitro, and Spc42 phosphorylation in vivo depends on Mps1. In mps1-1, Spc42 assembly is abnormal, and Mps1 controls Spc42 assembly during SPB duplication (11827982). There is no direct test by phosphosite mutation, so confidence is medium
SPOUT メチル基転移酵素 Upa1 は Cse4-R37 のメチル化に寄与し: The SPOUT methyltransferase Upa1 contributes to Cse4-R37 methylation, and UPA1 overexpression causes chromosomal instability (37436802)
SPS 経路の Stp1 は MAE1・OAC1 のプロモーターに直接結合して発: Stp1 of the SPS pathway binds directly to the MAE1 and OAC1 promoters and controls their expression (25825491)
SPS 経路の正の調節因子 Yck1・Yck2 は Ptr3 の過剰なリン酸化に: Yck1 and Yck2, positive regulators of the SPS pathway, are required for hyperphosphorylation of Ptr3, which correlates with SPS pathway activation. CKI and PP2A act oppositely (17984223)
SPS1/SPO77 の経路は Ssp1 の適切なリン酸化と安定性（前胞子膜が閉: The SPS1/SPO77 pathway is required for proper phosphorylation and stability of Ssp1 (its removal and degradation when the prospore membrane closes) (27182947)
SPS4 の胞子形成特異的な発現は IME2 の変異で遅れる。UME6 変異では: Sporulation-specific expression of SPS4 is delayed in IME2 mutants. In UME6 mutants, expression does not occur during vegetative growth (7791799)
SRB4 の 1 アミノ酸変異が med6 温度感受性の転写欠損を抑圧し、Med: A single amino acid mutation in SRB4 suppresses the temperature-sensitive transcription defect of med6, and Med6 and Srb4 belong to the same Mediator subcomplex (9710620)
SRB6 は srb4 温度感受性変異の優性サプレッサーとして得られ、その産物は: SRB6 was obtained as a dominant suppressor of a temperature-sensitive srb4 mutation, and its product physically binds Srb4 (9671455)
SRP のコアタンパク質（Srp21 など）の核小体への取り込みに Pse1 と: Import of SRP core proteins (such as Srp21) into the nucleolus requires Pse1 and Kap123 (11352936)
SRP 受容体の beta サブユニット Srp102p は Srp101p と: The SRP receptor beta subunit Srp102p binds Srp101p, and loss of binding abolishes function (9679135)
SSD1 の欠失で Ssd1 が結合する SRL1 mRNA の非対称な局在が強: SSD1 deletion strongly impairs asymmetric localization of SRL1 mRNA, which Ssd1 binds. Phosphomimetic Ssd1 promotes polarized localization of SRL1 mRNA, while non-phosphorylated Ssd1 constitutively localizes it to P-bodies (21339329)
SSD1-V の Ssd1（ssd1-d でない）は CLN2 mRNA の一部: Ssd1 of SSD1-V (not ssd1-d) stabilizes part of CLN2 mRNA and helps sustain CLN2 transcription after heat shock. Both depend on the 5′ UTR of CLN2 mRNA, which Ssd1 binds (20977549)
SSF1・SSF2 の単独欠失は表現型がないが、両方の欠失は致死（7748491: Single deletions of SSF1 or SSF2 have no phenotype, but deletion of both is lethal (7748491). They are redundant essential genes, and their overexpression increases mating efficiency of ste4 mutants (9611192)
SSK1 の受容ドメインが SSK2 の N 末端に結合して潜在的なキナーゼ活性: The SSK1 receiver domain binds the SSK2 N-terminus, unmasking latent kinase activity and causing SSK2 autophosphorylation
SSK2/SSK22 は SLN1・YPD1・SSK1 の二成分系で活性化される: SSK2/SSK22 are activated by the SLN1-YPD1-SSK1 two-component system (details of activation by binding are shown for SSK2)
SSU プロセソームでの Mpp10p–Imp4p の結合を逆ツーハイブリッドで: Mpp10p-Imp4p binding in the SSU processome was examined by reverse two-hybrid. imp4 mutants with weak binding are defective in pre-rRNA processing (14990745)
STB5 の過剰発現で、グルコース制限のとき Stb5 の標的とされる GND1: STB5 overexpression collectively induced the putative Stb5 targets GND1/2, TAL1, ALD6 and YEF1 under glucose limitation (30924859). Med3 partners with Stb5 to control gnd1 and ald6 expression under hyperosmotic stress (39082808)
STB5 欠損株のトランスクリプトームで PP 経路の多くの遺伝子は変わるが Z: In the transcriptome of the STB5 deletion strain, many PP pathway genes change, but Zwf1 is not among them (30107458) (PMID: 30107458)
STL1 プロモーターの Hog1 応答要素は Hot1 の直接の標的で、hot: The Hog1 response element of the STL1 promoter is a direct Hot1 target, and STL1 was the only gene whose expression was lost in hot1Δ (25904326). Under hyperosmotic stress, the Hot1 target STL1 is activated variably from cell to cell (24817120)
STU1 は β チューブリン変異 tub2-406 の抑圧遺伝子。TUB1・T: STU1 is a suppressor of the β-tubulin mutation tub2-406. Genetic interactions with TUB1 and TUB2 mutations suggest that Stu1 interacts with microtubules (7806575)
STUbL の Slx5-Slx8 は MATα2 の分解を担う主なリガーゼで、: The STUbL Slx5-Slx8 is the main ligase for MATα2 degradation and binds and ubiquitinates α2 directly without SUMO (20388728). Slx5/Slx8 directly ubiquitinates a C-terminal fragment of α2, and mutations in the degradation signal impair this ubiquitination. α2 is also ubiquitinated via the Doa10 (Ubc6, Ubc7) pathway (26246605)
SUT1 の発現は自己制御され、Ste12 に抑えられる（23223039）: SUT1 expression is autoregulated and repressed by Ste12 (23223039)
SWI/SNF と RSC に含まれる Arp7 と Arp9 は機能単位として: Arp7 and Arp9, contained in SWI/SNF and RSC, form a stable heterodimer as a functional unit (12805231)
SWI1・SWI2(SNF2)・SWI3 は HO と INO1 の転写に必要。: SWI1, SWI2 (SNF2) and SWI3 are required for transcription of HO and INO1, and also of ADH1, ADH2, SUC2, GAL1 and others (1339306)
SWI1・SWI2(SNF2)・SWI3・SNF5・SNF6 の産物が約 2 M: The products of SWI1, SWI2 (SNF2), SWI3, SNF5 and SNF6 form a single complex of about 2 MDa (8159677)
SWI5 は HO の発現に要る亜鉛フィンガータンパク質で、Pho2（Grf10: SWI5 is a zinc finger protein required for HO expression and binds the HO promoter cooperatively with Pho2 (Grf10) (7902583). Nuclear entry of Swi5 at the end of anaphase recruits Swi/Snf (10319811)
SWR1 のサブユニット Bdf1 は SWR1 のクロマチンへの結合を促し、Y: The SWR1 subunit Bdf1 promotes SWR1 binding to chromatin, and Yaf9 slows its dissociation. They contribute to targeting to the +1 nucleosome and histone exchange (40768570)
SYH1 の高発現が ebp2 変異の増殖とリボソーム形成の欠陥を一部抑圧し、s: High expression of SYH1 partially suppresses the growth and ribosome biogenesis defects of ebp2 mutants, and syh1Δ shows a synthetic growth defect with ebp2 (25849478)
Sac1 による PI4P の代謝には Osh タンパク質が要り、Osh による: PI4P metabolism by Sac1 requires Osh proteins, and stimulation of Sac1 activity by Osh was reconstituted in vitro. Osh3 activates Sac1 at ER-plasma membrane contact sites (21295699)
Sac3-Thp1-Sem1 の結晶構造と、構造に基づく変異で Thp1-Sac: The crystal structure of Sac3-Thp1-Sem1 and structure-based mutations show that Thp1-Sac3 binding is essential for mRNA binding and mRNP formation and export (22343721)
Sad1 は Brr2 による tri-snRNP の ATP 依存の解離に拮抗: Sad1 antagonizes Brr2-mediated ATP-dependent dissociation of the tri-snRNP, preserving the tri-snRNP (24190974)
Sae2 によるチェックポイント信号の減弱は Mec1 と Tel1 に依存した: Attenuation of checkpoint signaling by Sae2 requires Mec1- and Tel1-dependent Sae2 phosphorylation (31552432)
Sae2 は Tel1-Rad53 のチェックポイントを弱め、Mre11 のヌク: Sae2 dampens the Tel1-Rad53 checkpoint and prevents Rad9 accumulation at DSBs independently of the Mre11 nuclease. Sae2 competes with other Tel1 substrates, reducing Rad9 binding to chromatin and Rad53 (30510002)
Sae2 は減数分裂で Mec1・Tel1 にリン酸化され、その部位を Ala: Sae2 is phosphorylated by Mec1 and Tel1 in meiosis, and changing these sites to Ala impairs the initiation and efficiency of DSB end resection (18670132). Checkpoint attenuation by Sae2 requires Mec1/Tel1-dependent phosphorylation, which indirectly promotes resection by the Dna2-Sgs1 and Exo1 pathways (31552432)
Saf1p は転写後の段階で Aah1p の分解を促す。この制御はプロテアソーム: Saf1p promotes Aah1p degradation at a post-transcriptional step. This control is lost in proteasome or SCF mutants (16677311)
Sam35 を不安定にすると Sam50 の基質結合が妨げられる。Sam37 は: Destabilizing Sam35 blocks substrate binding by Sam50. Sam37 aids substrate release at a later step (17978093)
Sam37 は Tom22 の受容体ドメインと結合し TOM と SAM をつな: Sam37 binds the receptor domain of Tom22, linking TOM and SAM (26416958)
Sam5（Pet8）はミトコンドリアの SAM 輸送体で、欠失株はビオチン要求性: Sam5 (Pet8) is the mitochondrial SAM transporter, and the deletion strain requires biotin (biotin is made in mitochondria by the SAM-requiring Bio2) (14609944)
Sba1 は Hsp90 に結合し、Hsp90 の ATPase と阻害剤の結合: Sba1 binds Hsp90 and protects against Hsp90 inhibitors by hindering the Hsp90 ATPase and inhibitor binding (18362168)
Sbh1 は Rtn1 だけでなく Rtn2・Yop1 を含む複合体にも見つかる: Sbh1 is found not only with Rtn1 but also in complexes containing Rtn2 and Yop1 (19857245)
Sbp1 は Hmt1 に依存してアルギニンがメチル化され、メチル化はグルコース: Sbp1 is arginine-methylated in an Hmt1-dependent manner, and methylation increases upon glucose removal. A methylation-deficient mutant (AMD) is less prone to overexpression-induced growth inhibition and is defective in granule localization and granule formation. Sbp1-eIF4G1 binding is weakened in the AMD mutant and without Hmt1. The AMD mutant cannot complement decapping defects (31495062)
Scc1 の C 末端ドメインは Smc1 の頭部への ATP 結合を促して S: The Scc1 C-terminal domain promotes ATP binding to the Smc1 head, enhancing Smc1/Smc3 ATPase activity (17055978)
Scc2p は新しいタンパク質 Scc4p と複合体を作り、どちらも姉妹染色分体: Scc2p forms a complex with the new protein Scc4p, and both are required for sister chromatid cohesion (10882066)
Scc3 の I358 から SCD までの領域が Mcd1 との結合、コヒーシ: The Scc3 region from I358 to the SCD is required for binding Mcd1, cohesin localization to chromosomes, and cohesion (25748820)
Scc3・Pds5・Rad61 は複合体をつくって姉妹 DNA の取り込みを妨げ: Scc3, Pds5 and Rad61 form a complex that blocks entrapment of sister DNA, and Eco1 relieves this block and promotes entrapment (19328069)
Scd6 は RGG ドメインに依存して eIF4F の eIF4G に結合し、: Scd6 binds eIF4G of eIF4F in an RGG domain-dependent manner, forming mRNPs stalled at translation initiation and repressing translation (22284680). Arginine methylation by Hmt1 strengthens binding to eIF4G1 and enhances Scd6's repressive function. Methylation-deficient mutants fail to inhibit growth when overexpressed and fail to form stress granules (27613419)
Scd6 は RGG モチーフでアルギニンがメチル化され Hmt1 が主に担う。: Scd6 is arginine-methylated in its RGG motif, mainly by Hmt1. Methylation enhances Scd6 translational repression activity by promoting binding to eIF4G1. Methylation-deficient mutants cannot form stress granules and bind eIF4G1 poorly, and Scd6-eIF4G1 binding is also weak in strains lacking Hmt1 (27613419). Under glucose starvation and other stresses Scd6 gathers in P-bodies, which is prevented by hmt1 deletion or methylation-deficient mutation. Methylation by Hmt1 is required for Scd6 localization and function (for Dhh1-related phenotypes, methylation may act negatively) (27776129)
Sch9 が Rim15 を直接リン酸化して抑える。Rim15 の核内蓄積は T: Sch9 directly phosphorylates and inhibits Rim15. Nuclear accumulation of Rim15 is negatively controlled by TOR and Sch9 (14690612)
Sch9 と CK2 は栄養ストレスの下で協同して H3pT11 を調節し、H3: Sch9 and CK2 cooperatively regulate H3pT11 under nutrient stress, and loss of H3pT11 extends chronological lifespan (29938647). Full text: in YPglycerol, the H3pT11 increase is strongly impaired in sch9Δ (but not in ras2Δ or tor1Δ)
Sch9 に依存した Stu2 の核外輸送シグナル近くのリン酸化は、分裂期に入る: Sch9-dependent phosphorylation near the nuclear export signal of Stu2 prevents Stu2 accumulation in the nucleus before mitotic entry (28972103)
Sch9 の C 末端 6 残基を TORC1 が直接リン酸化し、そのリン酸化が: TORC1 directly phosphorylates the six C-terminal residues of Sch9, and this phosphorylation is required for Sch9 activity
Sch9 は PI(3,5)P2 との直接の結合で液胞に呼び寄せられ、そこで T: Sch9 is recruited to the vacuole by direct binding to PI(3,5)P2, where it is phosphorylated by TORC1 (24478451). PI(3,5)P2 made by Fab1 on vacuoles/endosomes recruits both TORC1 and Sch9 (36791155)
Sch9 は PKA と重なる部位で Maf1 をリン酸化し、sch9 欠損は: Sch9 phosphorylates Maf1 at sites overlapping with PKA, and sch9 deletion lowers Pol III transcription in a Maf1-dependent manner (19299514). Sch9 contributes to Maf1 hyperphosphorylation and cytoplasmic localization (19823048). Since Maf1 is a Pol III repressor, Sch9 inhibits Maf1
Sch9 は Sko1 が制御する遺伝子の発現に必要で、in vitro で S: Sch9 is required for expression of Sko1-controlled genes and phosphorylates Sko1 in vitro (acting as an osmotic stress transcriptional activator)
Sch9 は V-ATPase と物理的に結合し、グルコースに応じた組み立て・解: Sch9 physically binds V-ATPase, influencing its glucose-dependent assembly/disassembly and integrating TORC1 input (28604780 abstract). V-ATPase assembly in log phase increases in sch9Δ or with rapamycin (28604780 full text)
Sch9 は転写抑制因子 Stb3・Dot6・Tod6 を直接リン酸化して抑え、: Sch9 directly phosphorylates and inhibits the transcriptional repressors Stb3, Dot6 and Tod6, promoting Ribi and RP gene expression. Dephosphorylated Stb3 and others recruit RPD3L to repress (21730963)
Sco1 は Cox2 の CuA 部位の銅の付加に関わる。loop 8 の変異: Sco1 is involved in copper loading of the Cox2 CuA site. Loop 8 mutants bind copper and receive copper from Cox17 normally but are impaired in their function with Cox2 and cannot respire (18390903)
Scp160 の RNA 結合は Gpa1 の活性化で高まり、フェロモンの勾配感: Scp160 RNA binding increases upon Gpa1 activation and is required for pheromone gradient sensing, chemotropism and mating (22832273). Signaling by activated Gpa1 requires direct binding to Scp160 (14536090)
Scp160 は YOR338W などの特定の mRNA と結合し、欠失で YO: Scp160 binds specific mRNAs such as YOR338W, and deletion changes the level of YOR338W mRNA and its distribution to membrane fractions (12654998)
Sct1 は C16:0-CoA を脂質に取り込んで Ole1 による不飽和化か: Sct1 incorporates C16:0-CoA into lipids, keeping it away from desaturation by Ole1. Overexpression lowers desaturation (22323296)
Sdh5 は Sdh1 への FAD の共有結合に必要。推定結合面の変異でフラビ: Sdh5 is required for covalent attachment of FAD to Sdh1. Mutations in the putative binding surface abolish flavinylation (23062074)
Sdh6 と Sdh7 が Sdh1/Sdh2 中間体に結合して Sdh2 の成: Sdh6 and Sdh7 bind the Sdh1/Sdh2 intermediate, promoting Sdh2 maturation and protecting it from oxidants (24954417)
Sdh6 と Sdh7 は Sdh1/Sdh2 中間体に結合して Sdh2 の成: Sdh6 and Sdh7 bind the Sdh1/Sdh2 intermediate, advancing Sdh2 maturation and protecting it from oxidant damage. Sdh2 decreases in SDHAF3 deficiency (24954417)
Sdh8 はマトリックスで Sdh1 と特異的に結合し、Sdh2 との会合と S: Sdh8 binds Sdh1 specifically in the matrix and aids its association with Sdh2 and SDH assembly (24954416)
Sdo1 があると Efl1 の GTP の Km が半分になり、Sdo1 はヌ: Sdo1 halves the Km of Efl1 for GTP, and Sdo1 acts as a nucleotide exchange factor (23831625)
Sdo1 は前駆 60S からの Tif6 の解離と再利用に必須（1735389: Sdo1 is essential for release of Tif6 from pre-60S and its recycling (17353896)
Sds3 は Rpd3-Sin3 複合体の構成要素で、欠失すると Sin3 が: Sds3 is a component of the Rpd3-Sin3 complex; when deleted, Sin3 dissociates from Rpd3 and the remaining Rpd3 complex loses nearly all deacetylase activity (11024051)
Sec14 ファミリーの Sfh1（YKL091C）は Psd2 による PE: The Sec14-family protein Sfh1 (YKL091C) enhances PE synthesis by Psd2. Its overexpression in psd1-deficient strains restores growth on non-fermentable carbon sources (30958856)
Sec15 は分泌小胞に結合し、GTP 型 Sec4 と特異的に結合する（100: Sec15 binds secretory vesicles and specifically binds GTP-bound Sec4 (10022848). Polarized localization of Sec15 depends on active Sec4 and its GEF Sec2 (15647373)
Sec18 の ATP 加水分解で LMA1 は Vam3 の複合体に移り、これ: ATP hydrolysis by Sec18 transfers LMA1 to the Vam3 complex, stabilizing it (9657146)
Sec18 は Sec17 との接触面を介して Sec17 による膜融合を促し、: Sec18 promotes Sec17-driven membrane fusion via its contact surface with Sec17 and stabilizes Sec17 assembly on membranes (36103252)
Sec2 は Sec4 に直接結合し（ヌクレオチドのない Sec4 を好む）、G: Sec2 binds Sec4 directly (preferring nucleotide-free Sec4) and acts as an exchange factor promoting GDP release and GTP binding. In sec2 mutants, vesicles do not gather at the bud tip and Sec4 is mislocalized (9199166). The Sec2 N-terminus is the Sec4 exchange factor, and the C-terminus acts in vesicle transport (10747090)
Sec20 と Tip20 は Ufe1 と共沈し、Ufe1 の変異を Sec2: Sec20 and Tip20 co-precipitate with Ufe1, and Sec20 mutations compensate for Ufe1 mutations (9214619)
Sec22 は Ufe1・Sec20 と共沈し、SEC22 の多コピーが ufe: Sec22 co-precipitates with Ufe1 and Sec20, and multicopy SEC22 suppresses a temperature-sensitive ufe1 mutation allele-specifically (9214619)
Sec23 のユビキチン化は Rsp5 による。cdc48 温度感受性変異株では: Sec23 ubiquitination is mediated by Rsp5. In temperature-sensitive cdc48 mutants, ubiquitinated Sec23 accumulates and Sec23 is stabilized. Cdc48 controls proteasomal degradation of Sec23 (20846524)
Sec23 の仲間 Nel1 は COPII の成分とは結合しないが、Sar1: The Sec23 relative Nel1 does not bind COPII components but shows strong GAP activity toward Sar1. Loss of NEL1 in the sar1D32G background greatly reduces growth (24947508). A GAP converts Sar1 to the GDP form and stops it, so this is inhibition. Consistent with the GO direction (inhibition)
Sec3 の PH ドメインと Sso2 の結晶構造で、Sso2 の N 末端の: The crystal structure of the Sec3 PH domain with Sso2 shows that two N-terminal NPY motifs of Sso2 bind Sec3 synergistically, promoting secretory vesicle fusion (35979953)
Sec3 は GTP 型 Rho1 と直接結合し、Sec3 の極性のある局在を作: Sec3 binds GTP-bound Rho1 directly, and Rho1 is required to establish and maintain polarized Sec3 localization (11283608)
Sec36（COG1）は Sec34（COG3）・Sec35（COG2）と結合し: Sec36 (COG1) binds Sec34 (COG3) and Sec35 (COG2), and SEC36 mutations disrupt the complex (12006647)
Sec39（Dsl3）は Dsl1 複合体に含まれ、Dsl1 とともに SNAR: Sec39 (Dsl3) is part of the Dsl1 complex and, together with Dsl1, is required for stable binding of the SNARE Use1 to the Tip20-Ufe1-Sec20 complex (15958492)
Sec4 と結合できない Sro7 の変異で小胞のつなぎとめの大部分が失われ、遺: Sro7 mutations that cannot bind Sec4 abolish most vesicle tethering, and genetically too, Sec4 binding is important for most of Sro7's in vivo function (29668350)
Sec4 のリン酸化は Sec15 を介したエキソシストとの結合を壊して Sec: Sec4 phosphorylation disrupts its Sec15-mediated binding to the exocyst, negatively regulating Sec4 function. Phosphorylation is a cell cycle-dependent event associated with cytokinesis; a kinase screen identified Cdc5 as a positive regulator of the phosphorylation, inferred to be a direct substrate from spatiotemporal colocalization (27621363). Directness is inferred, so confidence is medium
Sec65 は SRP のサブユニットで、Srp54 が SRP に安定に結合す: Sec65 is an SRP subunit required for stable binding of Srp54 to SRP (1313947)
Sec7 は Arf1 を正のフィードバックで活性化し、自己抑制も受ける（225: Sec7 activates Arf1 by positive feedback and is also autoinhibited (22516198 full text). Sec7-dependent Arf1 activation recruits Pik1 to the late Golgi/TGN (33788598 full text)
Sec7 は Ypt1・Ypt31/32 の効果分子でもあり、Ypt1 は主に: Sec7 is also an effector of Ypt1 and Ypt31/32, and Ypt1 mainly affects Sec7 membrane localization (25220393). Full text: Ypt1 recruits Sec7 on liposomes, and Sec7 disperses into the cytoplasm in ypt1-3 strains
Sec9 は試験管内・体内で Kin1/Kin2 の基質と確かめられ、Kin1: Sec9 was confirmed as a Kin1/Kin2 substrate in vitro and in vivo, and in vitro phosphorylation by Kin1 is enhanced by prior phosphorylation at the +2 position (30305396)
Sed5（重鎖）・Gos1・Ykt6（軽鎖）の t-SNARE の対になる v-: Sft1 is the v-SNARE partnering the t-SNARE of Sed5 (heavy chain), Gos1 and Ykt6 (light chains). The in vivo complex was confirmed by immunoprecipitation (11959998)
Seg1 は Pil1 のアイソソームへの効率的な取り込みと正常な細胞膜の溝の形: Seg1 is required for efficient incorporation of Pil1 into eisosomes and normal formation of plasma membrane furrows (22869600)
Sem1 が Rpn3 と Rpn7 をつかんで lid への順序立った組み込み: Sem1 grips Rpn3 and Rpn7 and mediates their ordered incorporation into the lid (24412063)
Sen1 が無いと、内在の Rnh1 が複製チェックポイント依存的に増え、ハイブ: Without Sen1, endogenous Rnh1 increases in a replication checkpoint-dependent manner and binds chromatin where hybrids accumulate (41236927)
Ser2 CTD キナーゼ Ctk1・Bur1 を欠く細胞では、ヘテロクロマチン: In cells lacking the Ser2 CTD kinases Ctk1 and Bur1, YFR057w in heterochromatin is barely activated (38615982)
Ser3 は Pib2 にのみ依存してリン酸化され、TORC1 活性の指標として: Ser3 is phosphorylated in a manner dependent only on Pib2 and was used as an indicator of TORC1 activity (38127619)
Ser3・Ser33 が α-ケトグルタル酸を D-2HG に還元する主な源で、: Ser3 and Ser33 are the main sources reducing α-ketoglutarate to D-2HG, and Dld3 oxidizes D-2HG to α-ketoglutarate (26774271)
Set1 の N 末と Swd2 は互いに結合し、どちらも CTD への効率的な: The Set1 N-terminus and Swd2 bind each other, and both are required for efficient binding to the CTD (32358498)
Set1 の塩基性・Swd1 の酸性の部分を欠くと両者の結合が壊れ、Set1 の: Removing the basic part of Set1 or the acidic part of Swd1 disrupts their binding, lowers Set1 levels and abolishes H3K4 methylation (22147691)
Set1 は D-box をもち APC/C(Cdh1) に分解される。Cla4: Set1 has a D-box and is degraded by APC/C(Cdh1). Cla4 phosphorylates S228 within the D-box, inhibiting degradation and maintaining H3K4me3 levels (37774018)
Set1 は Nrd1 の適切な呼び込みに重要。SET1 欠失は nrd1 変異: Set1 is important for proper Nrd1 recruitment. SET1 deletion worsens the termination defect of nrd1 mutants (21709022)
Set2 による H3K36 メチル化が Ioc4 の PWWP ドメインを通じ: H3K36 methylation by Set2 recruits Isw1b to ORFs via the PWWP domain of Ioc4 (in vivo and in vitro) (22922743)
Set2 は H3 の K36 に特異的なメチル化酵素で、体内の K36 のメチ: Set2 is a methyltransferase specific for H3 K36 and is responsible for K36 methylation in vivo. Tethered to a promoter, it represses transcription (11839797). H3K36 methylation is required for Rpd3S activation; without Set2 or H3K36, acetylated histones accumulate in ORFs and transcription starts from cryptic promoters. K36 methylation also suppresses histone exchange (22914091)
Set3 が Snt1・YIL112w・Sif2・Cpr1・Hos2・Hst1: Set3 forms a single complex, Set3C, with Snt1, YIL112w, Sif2, Cpr1, Hos2 and Hst1 (11711434)
Set3 は Snt1・YIL112w・Sif2・Cpr1・Hos2・Hst1: Set3 forms a single complex, Set3C, with Snt1, YIL112w, Sif2, Cpr1, Hos2 and Hst1 (11711434)
Set3 forms a single complex, Set3C, with Snt1, YIL112w, Sif2, Cpr1, Hos2 and Hst1 (11711434)
Set5 は初めて見つかった H4 のメチル化酵素で、H4 の K5・K8・K1: Set5 is the first H4 methyltransferase identified and monomethylates H4 K5, K8 and K12. In set5Δ yeast, H4K5me1 and H4K8me1 are specifically reduced, and mass spectrometry also shows a large decrease in monomethyl H4 (22343720). Set5 is involved in stress response and genome stability, and repression of subtelomeric genes requires its MYND domain (31685550)
Sfi1 の C 末端には Cdk1 と Cdc5 のリン酸化部位があり、リン酸: The Sfi1 C-terminus has Cdk1 and Cdc5 phosphorylation sites, and phosphomimetic mutations block SPB duplication. Cdc14 dephosphorylates C-Sfi1 to prepare for the next duplication, and Cdc14 is integrated into Sfi1 as a positive signal for SPB duplication (24954044)
Sfi1 の C 末端には Cdk1 と Cdc5 のリン酸化部位がある。リン酸: The Sfi1 C-terminus has Cdk1 and Cdc5 phosphorylation sites. In phosphomimetic sfi1, cells enter metaphase with a single SPB, and Cdk1 and (more weakly) Cdc5 inhibit SPB duplication. Cdc14 dephosphorylates C-Sfi1 to prepare for the next duplication, and Mps1 promotes Sfi1 elongation in G1 (24954044). The contribution of Cdc5 is smaller than that of Cdk1, so confidence is medium
Sfi1 の Cdk1 部位を非リン酸化型にすると、複製した SPB の分離に欠: Making the Cdk1 sites of Sfi1 non-phosphorylatable causes defects in separating duplicated SPBs and SPB reduplication during mitosis (25340401). Phosphomimetic sfi1 gives cells with a single SPB in metaphase (24954044). Full text: S801, T816, S855, S882 and S923 are phosphorylated in vitro by the mitotic cyclin Clb2/Cdk1 (25340401)
Sfk1 は以前 PI4 キナーゼ Stt4 の調節に関わるとされたが、lem3: Sfk1 was previously thought to regulate the PI4 kinase Stt4, but its effect on PS/PE exposure in lem3Δ does not depend on Stt4 (29540528)
Sfp1 は Fhl1 と Ifh1 の核内の局在に影響し、Sfp1 がないと両: Sfp1 affects nuclear localization of Fhl1 and Ifh1; without Sfp1, both move to the nucleolar region and RP gene transcription decreases (15466158)
Sfp1 は Fhl1・Ifh1 の核局在に影響し、Sfp1 がないと両者が核小: Sfp1 affects nuclear localization of Fhl1 and Ifh1; without Sfp1, both move toward the nucleolus and RP gene transcription decreases. This is control of localization, not of transcription
Sfp1 は TORC1 と直接結合し、TORC1 によるリン酸化で働きが制御さ: Sfp1 binds TORC1 directly, and its function is controlled by TORC1 phosphorylation. Upon TOR inhibition, Sfp1 leaves RP gene promoters and exits the nucleus (15353587)
Sfp1 はプロテアソームで分解され、その調節された分解に Blm10 が要る。: Sfp1 is degraded by the proteasome, and its regulated degradation requires Blm10. In blm10Δ, Sfp1 is stabilized and increases in the nucleus under nutrient limitation (21209318)
Sfp1 は核内で RP 遺伝子のプロモーターに結合し発現を促す。RPL3 その: Sfp1 binds RP gene promoters in the nucleus and promotes their expression. RPL3 itself is not named in the abstract (the statement concerns RP genes as a whole)
Sgf11 は Ubp8 が SAGA に結合するのと H2B の脱ユビキチン化: Sgf11 is required for Ubp8 binding to SAGA and for H2B deubiquitination (15657441)
Sgf1（Cog4）は sec35-1 の多コピー抑圧因子で、ツーハイブリッドと: Sgf1 (Cog4) is a multicopy suppressor of sec35-1 and, by two-hybrid and co-precipitation, a new subunit of the Sec34/Sec35 complex (11733049)
Sgm1 は Ypt6 によりゴルジに呼び込まれ、保存されたコイルドコイルで Y: Sgm1 is recruited to the Golgi by Ypt6 and binds Ypt6:GTP via a conserved coiled coil (15128430)
Sgo1 が特定の PP2A を動原体に呼び込み、その不活性化で第一分裂後期に動: Sgo1 recruits a specific PP2A to centromeres, and its inactivation causes loss of centromeric cohesin in anaphase I. Artificially recruiting PP2A to chromosome arms prevents Rec8 phosphorylation and blocks chiasma resolution (16541024). Sgo1 and PP2A-Rts1 are central to centromeric cohesion protection (CCP) (29644457)
Sgo1 のセリンに富む領域（SRM）はコンデンシンとの結合とセントロメアへの呼: The serine-rich motif (SRM) of Sgo1 is required for condensin binding and centromere recruitment, and SRM phosphorylation disrupts this binding. Mps1 directly phosphorylates the SRM, regulating condensin binding (32810145). Full text: Mps1 inhibition abolishes Sgo1 phosphorylation, and Mps1 phosphorylates T159 in vitro. Phosphorylation suppresses part of Sgo1 function (condensin retention), which the authors interpret as releasing cargo to accept the next, so confidence is medium
Sgs1 の N 末端の酸性領域（R1）は Rpa70 と結合し、Mec1 の標: The N-terminal acidic region (R1) of Sgs1 binds Rpa70 and is a Mec1 target. When Mec1 phosphorylates R1 under HU, Sgs1 binds the Rad53 FHA1 tightly, fully activating Rad53 and recruiting it to stalled forks (22820947). This concerns Sgs1's role as a checkpoint scaffold rather than its helicase function, so confidence is medium. BioGRID's 24035500 is a TORC2 paper, and Mec1 phosphorylation of Sgs1 does not appear in its abstract
Sgs1 のヘリカーゼの働きは CDK と Cdc5 で細胞周期に合わせて調節さ: Sgs1 helicase function is regulated through the cell cycle by CDK and Cdc5. In S phase/prophase I, CDK phosphorylation enhances Sgs1 unwinding, and subsequent hyperphosphorylation by Cdc5 appears to lower Sgs1 activity (while activating Mus81-Mms4 and others) (32504558). Stated as 'appears', so confidence is medium
Sgs1 はポリ SUMO 鎖に結合し Smc5/6 と結合する。これらが組換え: Sgs1 binds poly-SUMO chains and binds Smc5/6. These support SUMOylation of Sgs1, Top3 and Rmi1 when recombination structures form. Reduced STR SUMOylation causes accumulation of recombination structures and reduced growth under conditions with many such structures. SUMOylation promotes binding among STR subunits and their accumulation at repair sites. Full text: SUMOylation of Top3 and Rmi1 depends mainly on the SUMO ligase activity of Mms21, with a minor contribution from Siz2 (27373152)
Sgt1 と Hsp90 が Skp1 と Ctf13 の結合を促し、CBF3: Sgt1 and Hsp90 promote Skp1-Ctf13 binding, activating Ctf13 in CBF3 assembly (15340069)
Sgt1 は Cyr1 と物理的に結合し、sgt1 変異で cAMP 経路の活性: Sgt1 physically binds Cyr1, and sgt1 mutations alter cAMP pathway activity. Sgt1 is an activator of adenylate cyclase (12456005). Hsp90-Sgt1 cooperation maintains Cyr1 activity (22461145)
Sgt2 の N 末端領域と Get5 の UBL 領域が直接結合し、TA タン: The N-terminal region of Sgt2 and the UBL region of Get5 bind directly, handing TA proteins to the Get4/Get5 complex. The structure of the complex was determined (23297211)
She1 はダイナクチンと関係なくモータードメインに直接働いてダイニンの微小管上: She1 acts directly on the motor domain, independently of dynactin, strongly inhibiting dynein movement on microtubules. In cells, She1 weakens microtubule-cortex interactions on the mother side, biasing spindle movement toward the bud (23142046)
She2 の T109D 変異で四量体化と She3・Srp1 との相互作用が阻: The She2 T109D mutation inhibits tetramerization and interactions with She3 and Srp1 (36921931)
She2 は ASH1 mRNA の芽先端への局在に必要。リン酸化模倣変異で R: She2 is required for localization of ASH1 mRNA to the bud tip. Phosphomimetic mutations disrupt RNA binding and ASH1 mRNA localization (36921931)
She4p は Myo4p・Myo5p のモータードメインに UCS ドメインで: She4p binds the motor domains of Myo4p and Myo5p via its UCS domain and promotes Myo5p binding to actin filaments in vitro (12725728)
Shh4 は Δsdh4 を相補し、Sdh3 は Sdh4 または Shh4 と: Shh4 complements Δsdh4, and Sdh3 forms SDH isozymes with Sdh4 or Shh4 (22573324)
Sho1 の C 末端領域が Ste11 に結合してその活性化を担い、別の領域で: The C-terminal region of Sho1 binds Ste11 and mediates its activation, and a separate region binds Pbs2
Sho1 は Ste11 と結合する領域と Pbs2 と結合する領域をもち、St: Model in which Sho1 has a region binding Ste11 and a region binding Pbs2, acting as a joint scaffold that directs Ste11 to Pbs2 (15200959)
Shq1 と Naf1 は核に局在し、H/ACA snoRNP の中心タンパク質: Shq1 and Naf1 localize to the nucleus and interact with Nhp2 and Cbf5, core proteins of H/ACA snoRNPs (12228251)
Shq1 と Naf1 は複合体をつくるが、H/ACA snoRNP とは強く結: Shq1 and Naf1 form a complex but do not bind H/ACA snoRNPs strongly (12228251)
Shu 複合体の結晶構造で Csm2・Psy3・Shu1・Shu2 が順につなが: In the crystal structure of the Shu complex, Csm2, Psy3, Shu1 and Shu2 connect in sequence to form a V shape. Key residues were verified by pull-down and in vivo (29069504)
Sif2 は Sir4 の N 末端と結合し、sif2 欠失でテロメアの抑制が強: Sif2 binds the Sir4 N-terminus, and sif2 deletion strengthens telomeric silencing. Sif2 antagonizes Sir4 function at telomeres (9651685)
Sin3 の PAH2 ドメインを餌にしたツーハイブリッドで STB1-STB5: A two-hybrid screen using the Sin3 PAH2 domain as bait found STB1-STB5 and the STB2-like STB6 (9393435)
Sin3 の PAH2 領域を餌にしたツーハイブリッドで、Sin3 に結合するタ: A two-hybrid screen using the Sin3 PAH2 region as bait found STB1-STB5 as Sin3-binding proteins (9393435)
Sin3（PAH2）とのツーハイブリッドで STB1〜STB5 を同定。Stb1: STB1-STB5 were identified by two-hybrid with Sin3 (PAH2). Stb1 and Stb2 are contained in the Sin3 complex (9393435)
Sip1・Sip2・Gal83 はそれぞれ別のドメインで Snf1 と Snf4: Sip1, Sip2 and Gal83 each bind Snf1 and Snf4 through separate domains, tethering Snf1-Snf4 in the complex (9121458)
Sip2 のアセチル化は NuA4 と拮抗する Rpd3 脱アセチル化酵素が制御: Sip2 acetylation is controlled by the Rpd3 deacetylase antagonizing NuA4, and it strengthens binding to Snf1 (21906795)
Sip2 のアセチル化は NuA4 アセチル基転移酵素と Rpd3 脱アセチル化: Sip2 acetylation is antagonistically controlled by the NuA4 acetyltransferase and the Rpd3 deacetylase, and it strengthens binding to Snf1. Full text: Sip2 acetylation depends almost entirely on NuA4/Esa1 both in vivo and in vitro (21906795)
Sip3 は Snf1 との 2 ハイブリッドで同定され、DNA に結合した S: Sip3 was identified by two-hybrid with Snf1; it binds DNA-tethered Snf1 and activates target gene transcription (8127709)
Sip4 は two-hybrid で Snf1 と結合し、Sip4 による転写: Sip4 binds Snf1 by two-hybrid, and transcriptional activation by Sip4 is glucose-regulated and Snf1-dependent. Sip4 phosphorylation requires Snf1 (8628258). Under glucose limitation, Snf1 rapidly phosphorylates and activates Sip4 via Gal83 (10581241)
Sir1 は Orc1 の BAH 領域と結合して HMR・HML のサイレンシ: Sir1 binds the BAH region of Orc1 and establishes silencing at HMR and HML. Crystal structure of the OIR-BAH complex (15932939)
Sir2 の PMA1 などの転写抑制は、cAMP-PKA と CK2 による: Transcriptional repression of PMA1 and others by Sir2 is released by S473 phosphorylation by cAMP-PKA and CK2
Sir2 は Hsf1 の熱ショック応答に必須で、UPR による Hsf1 の活: Sir2 is essential for the Hsf1 heat shock response and is also required for UPR-induced Hsf1 activation. Increasing Sir2 strengthens UPR-induced Hsf1 activation (25600811). In sir2Δ, Hsf1 does not respond to heat shock, and increasing Sir2 mimics the heat shock response (25356557)
Sir2 は MATa 細胞で RDT1 のプロモーターに呼び込まれて転写を抑え: In MATa cells Sir2 is recruited to the RDT1 promoter and represses transcription, and it is released upon HO cleavage of MAT (31461456)
Sir2 は NAD 依存のヒストン脱アセチル化酵素で H4 の K16 を特異: Sir2 is an NAD-dependent histone deacetylase that specifically deacetylates H4 K16, and this activity mediates silencing. H4 K16 deacetylation is required for Sir3 binding (10693811). H4 K16 deacetylation by Sir2 is thought to spread Sir protein binding (17889663). BioGRID's 22654676 is a paper on the Sir4 N-terminus. HHF1 and HHF2 encode the same H4
Sir2 は Sir3・Sir4 と組んで HMLalpha2 などの沈黙したプ: Sir2, with Sir3 and Sir4, represses transcription of silenced promoters such as HMLalpha2. It does not block Pol II binding but targets the transition to elongation (18391020)
Sir2 は Sir3・Sir4 と組んでサイレンシングをつくり、HMRa1 と: Sir2, with Sir3 and Sir4, establishes silencing and blocks the transition from initiation to elongation at the HMRa1 and HMLα1/α2 promoters (18391020)
Sir2 はテロメアのヘテロクロマチンで H3 K56 を直接脱アセチル化してク: Sir2 directly deacetylates H3 K56 in telomeric heterochromatin, compacting chromatin and enabling silencing (17889663)
Sir3 の N 末端のアラニンは NatA でアセチル化され、ard1・nat: The N-terminal alanine of Sir3 is acetylated by NatA, and the silencing defects of ard1 and nat1 mutants are explained by lack of Sir3 acetylation (15454564)
Sir3 は NatA の基質で、ard1・nat1 変異株での Sir3 のア: Sir3 is a NatA substrate, and lack of Sir3 acetylation in ard1 and nat1 mutants explains the silencing defects (15454564)
Sir4・Esc1・Siz2・Nup170 が互いに物理的・機能的に相互作用し、: Sir4, Esc1, Siz2 and Nup170 interact physically and functionally with one another, forming a complex with some nucleoporins that is separate from the NPC (28883038)
Sit1 に結合できない Aft1 の Y179F 変異では Sit1 の分解が: In the Aft1 Y179F mutant, which cannot bind Sit1, Sit1 degradation increases and FOB uptake decreases (26323600)
Sit4 は Snf1 T210 の脱リン酸化に関わる（21464305）。グル: Sit4 is involved in dephosphorylation of Snf1 T210 (21464305). In high glucose, Reg1-Glc7 and Sit4 dephosphorylate T210 (24019512). Snf1 is activated by T210 phosphorylation
Siw14/Oca3 の過剰発現が oca1 ほかの欠失株のカフェイン感受性を抑: Siw14/Oca3 overexpression suppresses the caffeine sensitivity of oca1 and other deletion strains, suggesting a functional connection (21409566)
Siz1 と Siz2 は Rsp5 のユビキチン化の基質で、ユビキチン化された: Siz1 and Siz2 are substrates of Rsp5 ubiquitination; ubiquitinated Siz1 has reduced SUMO ligase activity, altering poly-SUMO chain formation (23443663)
Siz1/Siz2 は Sgo1 を SUMO 化し、SUMO 化は Sgo1: Siz1/Siz2 SUMOylate Sgo1, and SUMOylation weakens Sgo1-PP2A binding, enabling stable biorientation (33929514). Full text: without Siz1/Siz2, Sgo1 is stabilized, CPC removal is insufficient and biorientation becomes unstable
Siz1/Siz2 は動原体周辺の Sgo1 を張力依存の離脱の前に SUMO: Siz1/Siz2 SUMOylate pericentromeric Sgo1 before its tension-dependent removal, and Sgo1 SUMOylation weakens its binding to PP2A. This is important for stable biorientation (33929514). Full text: a genetic screen found Siz2 as a negative regulator of Sgo1; Siz2 antagonizes Sgo1 and promotes anaphase onset. Without Siz1/Siz2, Sgo1 is stabilized
Sjl2 の皮質への局在には Abp1 が要り、Abp1 は Sjl2 と物理的: Cortical localization of Sjl2 requires Abp1, and Abp1 physically binds Sjl2 (15798181)
Ska1 は SKI 複合体（Ski2-Ski3-Ski8）の一部と結合する新し: Ska1 is a new factor that binds part of the SKI complex (Ski2-Ski3-Ski8). It acts in decay of mRNAs such as those with long 3'UTRs (31304628)
Skg6 と Tos2 の過剰発現で Hof1 の母娘の首への集まりと隔壁形成が: Overexpression of Skg6 and Tos2 impairs Hof1 accumulation at the mother-daughter neck and septum formation. skg6 deletion suppresses the growth defect of hof1 deletion (16816427)
Skg6 と Tos2 の過剰発現で Hof1 の首への集まりが損なわれる（16: Overexpression of Skg6 and Tos2 impairs Hof1 accumulation at the neck (16816427)
Ski2・Ski3・Ski8 は共免疫沈降で複合体を作り、Ski3-Ski8 の: Ski2, Ski3 and Ski8 form a complex by co-immunoprecipitation, and Ski3-Ski8 binding does not require Ski2 (10744028)
Ski7 は Ski8 と Ski3 を介して Ski 複合体と結合する（ツーハ: Ski7 binds the Ski complex via Ski8 and Ski3 (two-hybrid, co-immunoprecipitation) (16043509)
Ski8 が無いと Ski2 は Ski3 と、Ski3 が無いと Ski2 は: Without Ski8, Ski2 does not associate with Ski3, and without Ski3, Ski2 does not associate with Ski8 (10744028)
Skn7 の HSF 様 DNA 結合ドメインが OCH1 の上流のシス配列に結: The HSF-like DNA-binding domain of Skn7 binds a cis element upstream of OCH1 (title: Sln1 controls OCH1 through Skn7) (11854400)
Sko1 の 5 つの標的（SFA1 を含む）は酸化ストレスで誘導され、その誘導: Five Sko1 targets (including SFA1) are induced by oxidative stress, and Yap1 is involved in their induction (11401713)
Sko1 は HOG 経路依存の制御を担う抑制因子で、SFA1 などが Hog1: Sko1 is a repressor mediating HOG pathway-dependent control, and SFA1 and others are Hog1-Sko1 targets (11401713)
Sko1 は Hog1 を不活性化するホスファターゼ PTP3 のプロモーターに: Sko1 binds the promoter of PTP3, a phosphatase that inactivates Hog1, and is required for PTP3 induction under osmotic stress (16087739)
Sko1 は MSN2 のプロモーターに結合し、sko1 変異株では浸透圧ストレ: Sko1 binds the MSN2 promoter, and in sko1 mutants induction of MSN2 expression under osmotic stress is weakened (16087739)
Sko1 は Tup1-Cyc8 を標的プロモーターに呼ぶ DNA 結合タンパク: Sko1 is a DNA-binding protein that recruits Tup1-Cyc8 to target promoters. The Sko1-controlled GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed in unstressed conditions in tup1 and cyc8 mutants (18201562)
Skp1・Cdc53・Cdc4 は SCF-Cdc4 をつくり、Cdc34・E1: Skp1, Cdc53 and Cdc4 form SCF-Cdc4, which acts with Cdc34 and E1 as the ubiquitin ligase for Sic1. Cdc4 selectively binds phosphorylated Sic1 (9346238). Sic1 degradation is required for the G1/S transition and requires Cdc4 and others. Ubiquitin chains on Sic1 do not form in cdc4ts extracts (9285816)
Sks1 依存のリン酸化を Bud6・Itr1・Lrg1・Npr3・Pda1 に: Sks1-dependent phosphorylation was found on Bud6, Itr1, Lrg1, Npr3 and Pda1, and Pda1 Y309 and S313 are required for pseudohyphal growth (24603354)
Sky1 は Npl3 の 8 つの SR/RS のうち C 末端の 1 つだけ: Sky1 phosphorylates only one, the C-terminal one, of the eight SR/RS dipeptides of Npl3. Changing this RS to RA or lacking SKY1 causes Npl3 to accumulate in the cytoplasm, with increased binding to poly(A)+ RNA and reduced binding to the import receptor Mtr10 (11233987). Sky1 phosphorylation regulates binding of the RGG motif to Mtr10, determining Npl3 nuclear import, and arginine methylation interferes with this phosphorylation (10952997)
Sla2 は Pan1 の Arp2/3 活性化を試験管内で特異的に抑え、pan: Sla2 specifically inhibits Pan1's Arp2/3 activation in vitro, and partial-loss pan1 mutations suppress the temperature sensitivity, endocytosis and actin defects of sla2ΔCC (17151356)

Sln1 のアスパラギン酸のリン酸は Ypd1 に渡り、Ypd1 は応答調節因子: Phosphate on the Sln1 aspartate is transferred to Ypd1, and Ypd1 transfers phosphate to the conserved aspartates of the response regulators Ssk1 and Skn7 (12455952). ypd1 deletion lowers Skn7 transcriptional activity, which depends on D427 (9790591)

Slx9 は RanGTP と NES を Crm1 に差し出す足場で、40S: Slx9 is a scaffold that presents RanGTP and the NES to Crm1, triggering nuclear export of 40S precursors (25895666)

Smd1p の変異で低温の生育に Lhp1p が必要になる。pre-U4 RNA: Smd1p mutations make Lhp1p necessary for growth at low temperature. Pre-U4 RNA is bound by Smd1p, and Lhp1p aids efficient binding of Sm proteins (10747032)

Smf1 degradation requires Bsd2 plus either Tre1 or Tre2 (16456538)

Smk1 は Ssp2 とともに減数第二分裂後半に LEP と一時的に局在し、先: Smk1, together with Ssp2, transiently localizes to the LEP in late meiosis II, and its localization to the leading edge depends on Ady3 (33466572)
Smk1 は部分的に重複するグルカン合成酵素 Gsc2 と Fks3 を介して胞: Smk1 promotes deposition of the spore wall glucan layer via the partially redundant glucan synthases Gsc2 and Fks3 (38874213)
Smt1 は ATP6/8 mRNA の翻訳抑制因子で、変異で Atp6・Atp: Smt1 is a translational repressor of ATP6/8 mRNA, and its mutation restores Atp6 and Atp8 translation (26823015)
Smt3 は Uba2 と Aos1 からなるヘテロ二量体の E1 によって A: Smt3 is activated ATP-dependently by a heterodimeric E1 consisting of Uba2 and Aos1. AOS1 and UBA2 are both essential (9312010)
Smt3 は Uba2 と Aos1 のヘテロ二量体の酵素で ATP 依存的に活: Smt3 is activated ATP-dependently by the Uba2-Aos1 heterodimeric enzyme (9312010)

Sna4 の PPPY モチーフが Rsp5 との相互作用に関わり、モチーフの変: The PPPY motif of Sna4 is involved in interaction with Rsp5, and motif mutation or reduced Rsp5 blocks entry into MVBs. Sna4 is polyubiquitinated on its single lysine (19168755)
Snf1 が Cyr1 をリン酸化し、cAMP と PKA 依存の転写を負に制御: Snf1 phosphorylates Cyr1 and negatively regulates cAMP- and PKA-dependent transcription
Snf1 が Hxk2 の Ser14 をリン酸化すると核への輸入が減り輸出が増: Snf1 phosphorylation of Hxk2 Ser14 decreases its nuclear import and increases export (reducing its function in the nuclear repressor complex)
Snf1 がグルコース飢餓と Ca2+ による GPX1 の発現に関わる。snf: Snf1 is involved in GPX1 expression induced by glucose starvation and Ca2+. Onset of induction is delayed in snf1Δ (20002498)
Snf1 と Ypk1 による Rod1 のリン酸化は Rod1 を負に調節し、: Phosphorylation of Rod1 by Snf1 and Ypk1 negatively regulates Rod1, preventing it from promoting pheromone pathway desensitization (Ste2 internalization) (PMID 26920760). 17949685 shows S447 phosphorylation, but its effect is unclear
Snf1 と酵母の GSK3 はそれぞれ独立に Tda1 をリン酸化し活性化し、: Snf1 and yeast GSK3 each independently phosphorylate and activate Tda1, and Tda1 phosphorylates Hxk2 S15. Snf1 と酵母の GSK3 はそれぞれ独立に Tda1 をリン酸化し活性化する: Snf1 and yeast GSK3 each independently phosphorylate and activate Tda1. Tda1 S483/T484 are important for activation by Snf1 (40275108)

Snf1 に依存してリン酸化されるタンパク質の中に Ccr4・Dhh1・Xrn1: Proteins phosphorylated in a Snf1-dependent manner include Ccr4, Dhh1 and Xrn1, which are required for glucose-induced decay of Snf1-dependent mRNAs induced by glucose starvation. Changing three Snf1-dependent phosphorylation sites of Xrn1 reduces glucose-induced mRNA decay (25005228)

Snf1 は Hxk2 と恒常的に結合し、高グルコースでは Hxk2 が Snf: Snf1 constitutively binds Hxk2, and in high glucose Hxk2 blocks Snf1 phosphorylation of Mig1 Ser311. hxk2 mutations relieve glucose repression of Snf1
Snf1 は Msn2 の S582 を直接リン酸化して Msn2 の働きを抑え: Snf1 directly phosphorylates Msn2 S582, inhibiting Msn2 function
Snf1 は Sak1 を多くの部位でリン酸化して抑え、Sak1 による Snf: Snf1 phosphorylates Sak1 at many sites and inhibits it, limiting Sak1 phosphorylation of Snf1 T210 and nuclear accumulation of Snf1 (supporting sentence is in the PMC full text)
Snf1 はグルコース欠乏で Imh1 の S606・S802・S804 をリン: Under glucose deprivation, Snf1 phosphorylates Imh1 S606, S802 and S804, dissociating Arl1-Imh1 from the Golgi. Phosphomimetic mutants leave the Golgi, while non-phosphorylatable mutants do not. Snf1 binds Imh1 and phosphorylates it directly. This phosphorylation impairs its function supporting SNARE recycling in ypt6Δ and disrupts Golgi homeostasis (40560401)
Snf1 はラパマイシン感受性の TOR キナーゼに負に調節される。窒素の制限で: Snf1 is negatively regulated by the rapamycin-sensitive TOR kinase. Nitrogen limitation increases Snf1 Thr210 phosphorylation
Snf1 は代替炭素源での Psk1 の活性化に必要かつ十分で、Psk1 の移動: Snf1 is necessary and sufficient for Psk1 activation on alternative carbon sources, is required for the Psk1 mobility shift, phosphorylates Psk1 in vitro, and binds it via Gal83. Psk1 phosphorylates and activates Pbp1, and Pbp1 inhibits TORC1 by sequestration into stress granules (25428989)
Snf5 は Swp82・Taf14 と一つのサブモジュールをつくる（架橋質量分: Snf5 forms one submodule with Swp82 and Taf14 (crosslinking mass spectrometry and subunit deletion, 28249160)
Snf5-Swi3 部分複合体の結晶構造。この形成は SWI/SNF の働きに必: Crystal structure of the Snf5-Swi3 subcomplex. Its formation is required for SWI/SNF function (32284172)
Snf6 は ATPase サブユニット Snf2 の土台モジュールへの結合を安: Snf6 stabilizes binding of the ATPase subunit Snf2 to the base module (32636384)
Sng1 は Nce102 と物理的・遺伝学的に相互作用し、nce102Δ sn: Sng1 interacts physically and genetically with Nce102, and in nce102Δ sng1Δ, myriocin-induced hyperphosphorylation of Ypk1 and Orm2 does not occur (27033517)
Sni445 は 90S 前駆リボソーム内で Kre33 と物理的に結合し、欠損: Sni445 physically binds Kre33 within 90S pre-ribosomes, and its loss abolishes acetylation of C1280 and C1773 (41603732)
Snt2 と Ecm5 が Rpd3 を少数のプロモーターへ呼び込む（ChIP-: Snt2 and Ecm5 recruit Rpd3 to a small number of promoters (ChIP-seq) (23878396)
Snt2・Ecm5・Rpd3 は物理的に結合する（23878396）: Snt2, Ecm5 and Rpd3 physically associate (23878396)
Snu114 と Prp8 の結合領域の結晶構造。Prp8 の結合領域は Snu: Crystal structure of Snu114 with the binding region of Prp8. The Prp8 binding region abolishes the weak GTPase activity of Snu114 (32196113)
Snu13 が B/C モチーフに先に結合していると、Rrp9 の WD ドメイ: When Snu13 is pre-bound to the B/C motif, specific binding of the Rrp9 WD domain increases (23509373)
Snx3 は Neo1 の輸送に必要で、Neo1 の N 末端に Snx3 の選: Snx3 is required for Neo1 transport, and the Neo1 N-terminus contains a Snx3 sorting motif (28404745)
Snx4 は Snx4-Atg20 と Snx4-Snx41 の 2 つのヘテロ: Snx4 forms two heterodimers, Snx4-Atg20 and Snx4-Snx41. Snx4-Atg20 transports Snc1 (28026081)
Snx4 forms two heterodimers, Snx4-Atg20 and Snx4-Snx41. Snx4-Snx41 transports Atg27 (28026081)
Snx4 forms two heterodimers, Snx4-Atg20 and Snx4-Snx41 (28026081)
Snx4-Snx41 は Atg27 のエンドソームからゴルジへの逆行輸送を担う: Snx4-Snx41 mediates retrograde transport of Atg27 from endosomes to the Golgi (28026081)
Sod1 とその銅シャペロン Ccs1 は外の銅の欠乏に応じた Mac1 の活性: Sod1 and its copper chaperone Ccs1 act in Mac1 activation in response to external copper deficiency. Without CCS1, Mac1 target genes are not activated (18977757)
Sod1 の触媒活性が Mac1 の活性化と標的遺伝子のプロモーターへの結合に必: Sod1 catalytic activity is essential for Mac1 activation and binding to target gene promoters (18977757). Sod1 binds Mac1 and is important for its transcriptional activation and DNA binding (36456733)
Sof1 は U3 snoRNA と Nop1 と共免疫沈降する（8508778: Sof1 co-immunoprecipitates with U3 snoRNA and Nop1 (8508778)
Sog2 は Hym1・Kic1 と相互作用する。sog2 欠失で RAM 欠損: Sog2 interacts with Hym1 and Kic1. sog2 deletion causes the same cell separation and morphology defects as RAM loss (12972564)
Sov1 は VAR1 mRNA の翻訳を活性化し、合成直後の Var1 に結合: Sov1 activates translation of VAR1 mRNA and binds newly synthesized Var1 (32449921)
Spa2 と Pea2 は生体内で強く結合し、Bud6 とともに 12S 複合体: Spa2 and Pea2 bind tightly in vivo and appear to form a 12S complex with Bud6 (9632790)
Spa2 は Cyk3・Hof1・Chs2 に直接結合する。spa2Δ と cy: Spa2 binds Cyk3, Hof1 and Chs2 directly. Synthetic lethality of spa2Δ with cyk3Δ or hof1Δ is suppressed by a hyperactive Chs2, and increasing Spa2 promotes Chs2 incorporation at the division site and primary septum formation
Spb1 は生体内で Nop1 と Nop5/58 と結合している（106486: Spb1 associates with Nop1 and Nop5/58 in vivo (10648622)

Spc1 欠失で SPase による膜タンパク質の処理が増え、過剰発現で減る。S: Spc1 deletion increases SPase processing of membrane proteins, and overexpression reduces it. Spc1 is a negative regulator of SPase (34125229). The SPC consists of Spc1-3 and Sec11 (39565596)
Spc105/Kre28 は外側動原体での Ipl1・Sli15 の受容体。変異: Spc105/Kre28 is the receptor for Ipl1 and Sli15 at the outer kinetochore. Mutations impair correction of erroneous attachments, rescued by artificial recruitment of Ipl1 (40281358)
Spc110p の N 末端は Spc98p と強く結合し、この結合が Tub4: The Spc110p N-terminus binds Spc98p tightly, and this binding is key to anchoring the Tub4p complex to the SPB. Lethality of spc98-63 spc110-221 is due to loss of their binding (9693376)
Spc29 の T240 のリン酸化は SPB の複製と生存に要り、体内で Sp: Phosphorylation of Spc29 T240 is required for SPB duplication and viability and stabilizes Spc29 in vivo. Mps1 phosphorylates this site in vitro, and in strains with reduced Mps1 activity newly made Spc29 is unstable (19269975). Phosphorylation of this site by Mps1 in vivo is only 'suggested', so confidence is medium
Spc29 は G1 サイクリン（Cln1・Cln2）に特異的な K/R ドッキ: Spc29 is a G1-CDK substrate with a K/R docking motif specific for G1 cyclins (Cln1, Cln2) (34502421)
Spc2p を減らすと SPC の活性が下がり、小胞体の Sec11p と Sp: Depleting Spc2p lowers SPC activity and reduces levels of Sec11p and Spc3p in the ER (10921929)
Spc72 は Cdc5 と Ime2 に依存する経路で SPB から外され、こ: Spc72 is removed from the SPB by a Cdc5- and Ime2-dependent pathway, which is unleashed by APC/C-mediated degradation of Spo13 in anaphase I (35023198). Full text: in addition to Cdc5 activity, Ime2 activity is also required for Spc72 removal in anaphase I
Spc72 は分裂期に限って Cdc5 の PBD に結合し、試験管内で Cdc: Spc72 binds the Cdc5 PBD only in mitosis, is phosphorylated by Cdc5 in vitro, and inhibiting Cdc5 abolishes its mitotic phosphorylation (18022565). Full text: Cdc5 directly phosphorylates Nud1 and Spc72 in vitro (17967947)
Spc97 は two-hybrid で Spc98・Tub4 と結合し、免疫沈: Spc97 binds Spc98 and Tub4 by two-hybrid, and immunoprecipitation also shows a ternary complex (9130700)
Sph1p はツーハイブリッドで MAPKK の Mkk1p・Mkk2p・Ste: Sph1p binds the MAPKKs Mkk1p, Mkk2p and Ste7p by two-hybrid and binds Ste11 weakly (9443897)
Spn1 の転写装置への結合は結合相手の Spt6 に強く依存する（329416: Spn1 binding to the transcription machinery strongly depends on its partner Spt6 (32941642)
Spn1 は H3K36・H3K4 メチル化の分布を保ち、転写領域への Spt6: Spn1 maintains the distribution of H3K36 and H3K4 methylation, and binding of Spt6 and Set2 to transcribed regions partly depends on Spn1 (32941642)
Spo1 は Spo23（PI の合成を調節する）と物理的に結合する（17179: Spo1 physically binds Spo23 (which regulates PI synthesis) (17179081)
Spo13 は後期 I に分解される APC の基質で、L26 の変異で試験管内: Spo13 is an APC substrate degraded in anaphase I; the L26 mutation abolishes in vitro ubiquitination and makes it stable throughout meiosis (17493939). Cdc20-dependent degradation of Spo13 in anaphase I enhances Ama1 synthesis and activity, causing meiotic exit at meiosis II (37728253)

Spo73 は前胞子膜に局在し Spo71 と複合体を作る。SPO71 と同じく: Spo73 localizes to the prospore membrane and forms a complex with Spo71. Like SPO71, it is required for membrane extension (26605945)
Spo74 と Mpc70（SPO21）は減数分裂で SPB への呼び込みに互い: Spo74 and Mpc70 (SPO21) depend on each other for recruitment to the SPB in meiosis (12796288)

Spp381 の C 末端側半分が Prp38 と直接結合する（two-hybr: The C-terminal half of Spp381 binds Prp38 directly (two-hybrid). High expression of SPP381 suppresses prp38-1 (9858581)
Spt21 は S 期に Spt10 によってヒストン遺伝子のプロモーターに呼び: Spt21 is recruited to histone gene promoters by Spt10 in S phase (25228766)
Spt8 は TFIIS の N 末端ドメインの two-hybrid の相手で: Spt8 is a two-hybrid partner of the TFIIS N-terminal domain, and TFIIS binds SAGA in cell extracts (15359273)

Srb10 は Med2 と結合し、体内と試験管内でリン酸化する。Med2 の: Srb10 binds Med2 and phosphorylates it in vivo and in vitro. A point mutation at one Med2 phosphorylation site strongly lowers expression of the 2 μm plasmid genes REP1, REP2, FLP1 and RAF1 (14988503). The BioGRID PTM site is S208
Srb10p とサイクリン Srb11p が AAH1 の発現を転写の段階で制御: Srb10p and the cyclin Srb11p control AAH1 expression at the transcriptional level (16677311)
Srb10（Cdk8 = SSN3）は富栄養培地で Ste12 をリン酸化して不: Srb10 (Cdk8 = SSN3) phosphorylates and destabilizes Ste12 in rich medium, suppressing filamentous growth. Under nitrogen limitation, Srb10 levels and activity are lost, and phosphosite mutations increase pseudohyphal growth (12520306)
Srb10（Ssn3）と Kin28 はどちらも試験管内で Pol II CTD: Srb10 (Ssn3) and Kin28 both phosphorylate the Pol II CTD in vitro, but Srb10 acts as a negative regulator that phosphorylates the CTD before the initiation complex forms at the promoter, repressing transcription (9702190). BioGRID's 33523904 is a CKM structure paper, and 22124158 is a Phd1 paper
Srb10（Ssn3）は Gcn4 をリン酸化して SCF(Cdc4) に認識さ: Srb10 (Ssn3) phosphorylates Gcn4, making it recognized by SCF(Cdc4) and targeted for degradation. In srb10 mutants, Gcn4 phosphorylation and degradation decrease, and Gcn4 with all Srb10 sites changed is nearly stable (11331604)
Srb8・Srb9・Srb10・Srb11 が化学量論的な複合体として単離され、: Srb8, Srb9, Srb10 and Srb11 were isolated as a stoichiometric complex that phosphorylates the RNA polymerase II CTD (12200444)
Srf1 は Spo14 と物理的に相互作用し、体細胞分裂中の細胞の PLD 触: Srf1 physically interacts with Spo14 and is essential for PLD catalytic activity in mitotic cells (21347278)
Sro7 と Sro77 は細胞膜の SNARE Sec9 に結合することで見つ: Sro7 and Sro77 were found by their binding to the plasma membrane SNARE Sec9 (10402465)
Srp102 の活性の喪失は Srp101 との親和性の喪失と並行し、SR サブ: Loss of Srp102 activity parallels loss of affinity for Srp101, and binding between the SR subunits is important for function (9679135)
Srp1・Kap95・Sxm1 が Rrp6 の核への取り込みに最も重要なカリオ: Srp1, Kap95 and Sxm1 are the most important karyopherins for nuclear import of Rrp6 (28539363)
Srs2 の SUMO 化は PCNA との結合を弱める。STUbL の Uls: SUMOylation of Srs2 weakens its binding to PCNA. The STUbL Uls1 binds both PCNA and Srs2, reducing Srs2-SUMO at replication forks and promoting Srs2 binding to PCNA (28341648)
Srs2 は Rad51 のフィラメントを解体して相同組換えを制限し、Srs2: Srs2 disassembles Rad51 filaments, limiting homologous recombination, and without Srs2 Rad51 foci accumulate (19506039, in cells). Srs2 removes Rad51 from ssDNA (12748644, in vitro)
Srv2/CAP の N 末端半分がコフィリンによる繊維切断を直接促進する（結合: The N-terminal half of Srv2/CAP directly promotes cofilin-mediated filament severing (raising severing frequency without changing the amount bound) (23135996)
Ssa1 と Hsp40 の Ydj1・Hlj1 は Ste6p* の ERAD: Ssa1 and the Hsp40s Ydj1 and Hlj1 are important for ERAD of Ste6p* (15252059)
Ssa1 と Ssa2 はともに Ste5 の機能と接合応答に重要。両方を欠くと: Ssa1 and Ssa2 are both important for Ste5 function and the mating response. Loss of both impairs Ste5 levels and localization (37851593)
Ssa1 を FBPase の結合相手として同定し、ssa1-45(ts) 変異: Ssa1 was identified as an FBPase binding partner, and in the ssa1-45(ts) mutant polyubiquitination of FBPase by the Gid complex does not occur (20513352)
