Ssb はグルコースがあるとき SNF1 を脱リン酸化された状態に保つのに要る（: Ssb is required to keep SNF1 dephosphorylated in the presence of glucose (19723765). Increasing Ssb or Bmh lets Glc7 dephosphorylate SNF1 even without Reg1 (27001512)
Ssc1 の働きは Tim44・コシャペロン Mdj1・Mge1 との相互作用で: Ssc1 function is supported by interactions with Tim44 and the cochaperones Mdj1 and Mge1 (11601843). The 8943361 abstract also states that Mdj1 cooperates with mt-Hsp70 in the matrix, but it was removed from the PMIDs because Ssc1 is not named
Sse1・Sse2 は Hsp104 依存の脱凝集に必須で、Hsp110 がない: Sse1 and Sse2 are essential for Hsp104-dependent disaggregation; without Hsp110, accumulation of Hsp70 and Hsp104 at aggregates is impaired, and Hsp104 that arrives cannot disaggregate (28289075)
Ssh1p 複合体は Ssh1・Sbh2・Sss1 からなる三量体（861257: The Ssh1p complex is a trimer of Ssh1, Sbh2 and Sss1 (8612571)
Ssh4 はリジン飢餓のあとでだけ Ypq1 を認識する。Ypq1 の TM5・: Ssh4 recognizes Ypq1 only after lysine starvation. TM5 and TM7 of Ypq1 interact with the transmembrane part of Ssh4 (33351099)
Ssn6（Cyc8）は Aft1 と直接結合し、誘導時に FRE2 プロモーター: Ssn6 (Cyc8) binds Aft1 directly and acts as a coactivator at the FRE2 promoter upon induction (14739928)
Ssp120 は Emp47 と強く結合し、emp47Δ では Ssp120 が: Ssp120 binds Emp47 tightly, and in emp47Δ Ssp120 is mislocalized and secreted (26650540)
Sst2 の DEP ドメインが Ste2 への結合を担い、その結合が RGS: The Sst2 DEP domain mediates binding to Ste2, and this binding places the RGS near its substrate Gα, promoting inhibition. Sst2 binds only the unphosphorylated Ste2 tail (16990133)
Sst2 は Ste2 と結合し、フェロモン刺激した細胞の伸びる先端で受容体が戻: Sst2 binds Ste2 and is required for receptor return at the growing tip of pheromone-stimulated cells. It negatively controls G protein signaling but positively promotes receptor retention (26310439)
Ssu72 は CPF の Pta1 と組んで CTD の Ser5 リン酸を外: Ssu72, partnering with Pta1 of CPF, is a phosphatase that removes CTD Ser5 phosphate (15125841)
Ssy1 と Ptr3 は細胞膜にある外のアミノ酸のセンサーの成分。Ssy1 は: Ssy1 and Ptr3 are components of the plasma membrane sensor of external amino acids. Ssy1 requires the ER protein Shr3 to reach the plasma membrane, but Ptr3 does not (10409731)
Ssy1-Ptr3-Ssy5 アミノ酸センサー系が rho0 細胞での ATO3: The Ssy1-Ptr3-Ssy5 amino acid sensor system is preferentially required for high ATO3 expression in rho0 cells (12966084)
Ssy5 の活性化は、信号による前駆ドメインの Yck1/2 によるリン酸化に依: Ssy5 activation depends on signal-induced phosphorylation of its prodomain by Yck1/2, followed by SCF-Grr1-mediated ubiquitination and degradation (23447701). An amino acid-induced conformational change lets Yck1/2 phosphorylate the phosphodegron (21653827)
Ssy5 は Stp1 を切る内部プロテアーゼで、自身の切断が Stp1 の切断: Ssy5 is an endoprotease that cleaves Stp1, and its own cleavage is a prerequisite for Stp1 cleavage. Overproducing Ssy5 cleaves Stp1 without inducer and strongly transcribes AGP1 (15509782). In response to extracellular amino acids, Ssy5 cleaves and activates Stp1 and Stp2. Ssy5 is a serine protease (29661936)
Stb5 はペントースリン酸経路など NADPH を作る酵素の遺伝子を活性化する: Stb5 activates genes for NADPH-producing enzymes such as those of the pentose phosphate pathway. Its overexpression induced TAL1 and others under glucose limitation (30924859)
Std1 は Snf1 の触媒ドメインに結合し、Snf1 と Snf4 の結合を: Std1 binds the Snf1 catalytic domain and strengthens Snf1-Snf4 binding. Std1 overexpression raises Snf1 activity in vitro and in vivo (12618390)
Ste11 の膜への局在は Sho1 枝と糸状増殖の経路の活性化に必須で、Ste: Membrane localization of Ste11 is essential for activation of the Sho1 branch and the filamentous growth pathway and is mediated by Ste50 binding to Opy2. Ste50 binds Opy2 CR-A constitutively and CR-B in response to Yck1/2 phosphorylation (20932477)
Ste11 の膜への局在は糸状成長の MAPK 経路と Sho1 側の HOG: Membrane localization of Ste11 is essential for activation of the filamentous growth MAPK pathway and the Sho1 branch of the HOG pathway, and is mediated by binding of Ste50 to the membrane anchor Opy2 (20932477)
Ste11 は Nst1 を介して Mkk1/2 と直接結合し、熱やフェロモンで: Ste11 binds Mkk1/2 directly via Nst1, linking the HOG and pheromone pathways to the cell wall pathway under heat or pheromone
Ste11 は Pbs2 の活性化部位 Thr-518 をリン酸化する（3201: Ste11 phosphorylates Thr-518 in the activation site of Pbs2 (32011004). Sho1 activates Pbs2 and Hog1 via Ste11 (9180081)
Ste12 は Kap121 と Ran-GTP に感受性の形で特異的に結合し、: Ste12 binds Kap121 specifically in a Ran-GTP-sensitive manner and shifts to the cytoplasm in temperature-sensitive kap121 mutants. The mating and invasive growth defects of kap121 are suppressed by STE12 overexpression or addition of a classical NLS (11909949)
Ste12 は PRM1 プロモーターの 3 つの結合部位を介して PRM1 の: Ste12 increases PRM1 transcription via three binding sites in the PRM1 promoter (28986257)
Ste14 はメチル基転移酵素で、a-factor・RAS1・RAS2 は st: Ste14 is a methyltransferase; a-factor, RAS1 and RAS2 are not methylated in ste14 deletion. RAS2 maturation is slightly delayed (2050108)
Ste18 のリン酸化と Ste5 への Fus3 のドッキングが、Ste5 の: Ste18 phosphorylation and Fus3 docking on Ste5 determine the speed and stability of Ste5 binding to the plasma membrane. Disrupting both makes Fus3 activation faster and larger (29719261)
Ste20 の C 末端に Gβ の結合部位があり、その結合はフェロモンで調節さ: The Ste20 C-terminus has a Gβ binding site, and the binding is regulated by pheromone. Gβ or Ste20 mutations that abolish binding block MAP kinase pathway activation (9428767)
Ste20 の CRIB ドメインの点変異は Cdc42 との結合とフェロモン応: Point mutations in the Ste20 CRIB domain impair Cdc42 binding and pheromone response. GTP-bound Cdc42 enhances Ste20 kinase activity in vivo; CRIB is an autoinhibitory domain whose inhibition Cdc42 relieves. The same holds in the filamentous growth pathway (11940652). BioGRID's PMID 7651520 shows Cdc42 acts between the G protein and the kinase cascade in the pheromone pathway, but Ste20 does not appear in its abstract
Ste20 の PXXP 配列は Sho1 の SH3 ドメインに結合し、この結: The Ste20 PXXP sequence binds the Sho1 SH3 domain, and this binding contributes to Hog1 activation by Hkr1 but not by Msb2 (24570489)
Ste20 のリン酸化は細胞周期に依存し S 期に最大。Cln2 の過剰発現（C: Ste20 phosphorylation is cell cycle-dependent and peaks in S phase. Overexpression of Cln2 (not Clb2 or Clb5) shifts its mobility in a Cdc28-dependent manner, and in vitro only Cln2 complexes phosphorylate it (9774429). In vivo phosphorylation sites specifically dependent on Cln2 were identified (10359756)
Ste20 は生体内で Ste11 の S302・S306・T307 をリン酸化: Ste20 phosphorylates Ste11 S302, S306 and T307 in vivo. Making these sites non-phosphorylatable inactivates Ste11, while aspartate substitution makes it constitutively active without Ste20. Phosphorylation releases the N-terminal inhibitory domain (10837245)
Ste20・Cla4・Skm1 が Sut1 と複合体を作り、Sut1 標的のス: Ste20, Cla4 and Skm1 form a complex with Sut1, lowering expression of the Sut1-target sterol uptake genes (19793923)
Ste3 のユビキチン化はリガンド非依存の速い取り込みと液胞での分解を起こす。A: Ste3 ubiquitination causes ligand-independent rapid internalization and degradation in the vacuole. Mutations in Akr1 or the redundant Yck1 and Yck2 block ubiquitination and internalization. Ste3 deletion mutants are also defective in phosphorylation (10866691)
Ste4 はフェロモン刺激で Rsp5 に依存してユビキチン化され、Rsp5 を: Ste4 is ubiquitinated upon pheromone stimulation in an Rsp5-dependent manner; inactivating Rsp5 abolishes in vivo ubiquitination, and recombinant Rsp5 ubiquitinates Ste4 in vitro. The main site is K340; ubiquitination does not change Ste4 stability, but K340R cells polarize faster than wild type in a pheromone gradient (21685393)
Ste5 のユビキチン化は SCF(Cdc4) が担い、G1 の Cdk1 によ: Ste5 ubiquitination is mediated by SCF(Cdc4) and requires phosphorylation by G1 Cdk1. Degradation occurs mainly in the nucleus, and when it cannot be degraded the pathway is activated without pheromone (19001089)
Ste5 は Hsp70 の Ssa1 と結合し、Ssa1 と Ssa2 は合わ: Ste5 binds the Hsp70 Ssa1, and Ssa1 and Ssa2 together are required for Ste5 function and an efficient mating response. Loss of both impairs Ste5 levels, integrity and localization (37851593)
Ste5 は Ste11・Ste7・Fus3 を束ね、Ste11 が働くのに必要: Ste5 tethers Ste11, Ste7 and Fus3 and is required for Ste11 function (8062390). Through membrane binding by the Ste5 PH domain, Ste5-bound Ste11 is activated by membrane Ste20 (16847350). Binding of Gβ to the Ste5 LIM domain is essential for Ste11 activation (9501067)
Ste50 と Ste11 は N 末端どうしで結合し、この結合が Ste11: Ste50 and Ste11 bind via their N-termini, and this binding relieves the N-terminal inhibition of Ste11. It is required for Ste11 function in the HOG pathway and is important (not essential) in the mating pathway (10397774)
Ste50 の RA ドメインは侵入性増殖と HOG の信号に必須で、試験管内で: The Ste50 RA domain is essential for invasive growth and HOG signaling and binds Cdc42 rather than Ras2 in vitro. The RA domain can be replaced by the membrane-binding sequence of Cdc42; by binding Cdc42, Ste50 tethers Ste11 to the membrane and brings it to activated Ste20 (16428446)
Ste7 は二重特異性キナーゼで、Fus3 を正しい部位でリン酸化して活性を上げ: Ste7 is a dual-specificity kinase that phosphorylates Fus3 at the correct sites, increasing its activity (8384702). Fus3 is a poor Ste7 substrate, and a Ste5 domain makes Fus3 more readily phosphorylated. Because both Ste7 and Ste5 are required, Fus3 is activated only in the mating pathway (19303851)
Sth1 の ABD の保存されたアミノ酸が Sth1 の働きに必須。本文: I: Conserved amino acids in the Sth1 ABD are essential for Sth1 function. Full text: TAD1 and TAD2 of Ino2 bind Sth1 (39235627)
Sti1 は Ssa 群と特異的に結合し、Ssa1 の ATPase を約 20: Sti1 binds Ssa proteins specifically and activates the Ssa1 ATPase about 200-fold (12716905)
Sti1 は Ssa1 と酵母 Hsp90 をつなぐ三者複合体を作り、Hsp90: Sti1 forms a ternary complex bridging Ssa1 and yeast Hsp90, with two orders of magnitude higher affinity for Hsp90 (12716905)
Stp1 は MAE1 と OAC1 のプロモーターに直接結合して発現を制御する: Stp1 binds directly to the MAE1 and OAC1 promoters and controls their expression (25825491)
Stp1 はカゼインキナーゼ I に依存してリン酸化され、このキナーゼを欠く y: Stp1 is phosphorylated in a casein kinase I-dependent manner; in yck mutants lacking this kinase, Stp1 is not cleaved and amino acid-induced AGP1 induction does not occur (15509782)
Stp1・Stp2 は BAP2 プロモーターに直接結合する（11212916）: Stp1 and Stp2 bind directly to the BAP2 promoter (11212916)
Stp1 and Stp2 bind directly to the BAP2 promoter (11212916). Activation of the BAP2 promoter by amino acids in the medium depends on STP1 (9065387)
